Under normal circumstances, the fund invests at least 80% of its assets in equity securities and equity-related instruments that are tied economically to emerging markets. The equity securities and equity-related instruments in which it may invest include, but are not limited to, common stock, participation notes or other structured notes, and other instruments that provide economic exposure to one or more equity securities. The fund may also use exchanged-traded futures for the efficient management of cash flows.
info.description_zh: 摩根大通 ActiveBuilders 新興市場股票 ETF 旨在提供長期資本增值。正常情況下，該基金至少80%的資產投資於與新興市場經濟相關的股本證券和股票相關工具。其可能投資的股本證券及股本相關工具包括但不限於普通股、參與票據或其他結構性票據，以及提供一種或多種股本證券經濟風險的其他工具。該基金還可以使用交易所交易的期貨來有效管理現金流。

info.description: First Trust Emerging Markets AlphaDEX Fund seeks investment results that correspond generally to the price and yield (before the fund's fees and expenses) of an equity index called the NASDAQ AlphaDEX Emerging Markets Index. The fund will normally invest at least 90% of its net assets (including investment borrowings) in the securities that comprise the index. The index is designed to select stocks from the NASDAQ Emerging Markets Index (the "base index") that may generate positive alpha, or risk-adjusted returns, relative to traditional indices through the use of the AlphaDEX selection methodology.
info.description_zh: First Trust Emerging Markets AlphaDEX 基金尋求的投資結果通常與稱為納斯達克 AlphaDEX 新興市場指數的股票指數的價格和收益率（在基金費用和開支之前）相對應。該基金通常將至少 90% 的淨資產（包括投資借款）投資於構成該指數的證券。該指數旨在透過使用 AlphaDEX 選擇方法從納斯達克新興市場指數（「基礎指數」）中選擇相對於傳統指數可產生正 alpha 或風險調整回報的股票。

info.description: Rhythm Pharmaceuticals, Inc. is a commercial-stage biopharmaceutical company, which engages in the development and commercialization of therapeutics for patients with rare diseases. The firm offers IMCIVREE (setmelanotide), a precision medicine designed to treat hyperphagia and severe obesity caused by rare melanocortin-4 receptor (MC4R) diseases. It is also involved in the clinical development program for setmelanotide in other rare MC4R pathway diseases, as well as a preclinical suite of investigational candidates for the treatment of congenital hyperinsulinism. The company was founded by Bart Henderson in November 2008 and is headquartered in Boston, MA.
info.description_zh: Rhythm Pharmaceuticals, Inc. 是一家商業階段的生物製藥公司，致力於罕見疾病患者治療藥物的開發和商業化。該公司提供 IMCIVREE（setmelanotide），這是一種精準藥物，旨在治療由罕見的黑皮質素 4 受體（MC4R）疾病引起的食慾過盛和嚴重肥胖。它還參與了 setmelanotide 在其他罕見 MC4R 通路疾病中的臨床開發計劃，以及用於治療先天性高胰島素血症的臨床前研究候選藥物套件。該公司由 Bart Henderson 於 2008 年 11 月創立，總部位於馬薩諸塞州波士頓。

info.description: DraftKings, Inc. is a digital sports entertainment and gaming company, which engages in the provision of online sports betting, online casino, daily fantasy sports product offerings, DraftKings Marketplace, retail sportsbook, media, and other consumer product offerings. The company was founded by Jason D. Robins, Matthew Kalish, and Paul Liberman on December 31, 2011 and is headquartered in Boston, MA.
info.description_zh: DraftKings, Inc.是一家數位運動娛樂和遊戲公司，從事提供線上體育博彩、線上賭場、每日夢幻體育產品、DraftKings Marketplace、零售體育博彩、媒體和其他消費性產品。該公司由 Jason D. Robins、Matthew Kalish 和 Paul Liberman 於 2011 年 12 月 31 日創立，總部位於馬薩諸塞州波士頓。

info.description: Korro Bio, Inc. operates as a clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company, which engages in the discovery, development, and commercialization of a new class of genetic medicines based on editing RNA. The company was founded by Nessan Bermingham, Jean-Francois B. Formela, Joshua Rosenthal, and Andrew Fraley in 2018 and is headquartered in Cambridge, MA.
info.description_zh: Korro Bio, Inc. 是一家臨床階段生物製藥公司，致力於基於 RNA 編輯的新型基因藥物的發現、開發和商業化。該公司由 Nessan Bermingham、Jean-Francois B. Formela、Joshua Rosenthal 和 Andrew Fraley 於 2018 年創立，總部位於麻薩諸塞州劍橋。

info.description: Atlanta Braves Holdings, Inc. owns and operates a Major League Baseball (MLB) club. It operates through the Baseball and Mixed-Use Development segments. The Baseball segment includes its operations relating to the Braves baseball franchise and Truist Park and includes revenue generated from ticket sales, concessions, local broadcasting rights, advertising sponsorships, suites, and premium seat fees, retail and licensing revenue, shared MLB revenue streams, including national broadcasting rights and licensing, and other sources. Ticket sales, concessions, broadcasting rights and advertising sponsorship sales are the baseball segment's primary revenue drivers. The Mixed-Use Development segment includes retail, office, hotel and entertainment operations within The Battery Atlanta. The Battery Atlanta derives revenue primarily from office and retail rental income including overage rent and tenant reimbursements and, to a lesser extent, parking and advertising sponsorships. The company was founded on December 7, 2022 and is headquartered in Atlanta, GA.
info.description_zh: 亞特蘭大勇士控股公司 (Atlanta Braves Holdings, Inc.) 擁有並經營美國職棒大聯盟 (MLB) 俱樂部。它透過棒球和混合用途開發部門運作。棒球部门包括与勇敢者棒球特许经营权和Truist Park相关的业务，包括门票销售、特许权、当地广播权、广告赞助、套房和高级座位费、零售和许可收入、共享MLB收入流（包括国家广播权和许可）以及其他来源产生的收入。門票銷售、優惠、轉播權和廣告贊助銷售是棒球業務的主要收入來源。混合用途開發部門包括亞特蘭大砲台內的零售、辦公室、飯店和娛樂業務。亚特兰大炮台的收入主要来自办公室和零售租金收入，包括超额租金和租户报销，以及较小程度的停车和广告赞助。該公司成立於2022年12月7日，總部位於喬治亞州亞特蘭大。

info.description: Firefly Aerospace, Inc. engages in the design and manufacture of space launch vehicles. The company was founded by Thomas E. Markusic, Mark Watt, and Max Polyakov in January 2017 and is headquartered in Leander, TX.
info.description_zh: Firefly Aerospace, Inc. 從事航太運載火箭的設計與製造。該公司由 Thomas E. Markusic、Mark Watt 和 Max Polyakov 於 2017 年 1 月創立，總部位於德克薩斯州利安德。

info.description: SPDR Bridgewater ALL Weather ETF seeks to achieve long term capital appreciation. SSGA Funds Management, Inc. (the "Adviser" or "SSGA FM"), the investment adviser to the fund, seeks to achieve the fund's investment objective by investing the fund's assets based on a model portfolio provided by Bridgewater Associates, LP (the "Sub-Adviser" or "Bridgewater"), the investment sub-adviser to the fund.
info.description_zh: SPDR Bridgewater ALL Weather ETF 尋求實現長期資本增值。 SSGA Funds Management, Inc.（下稱「顧問」或「SSGA FM」）是該基金的投資顧問，旨在透過根據該基金的投資副顧問 Bridgewater Associates, LP（下稱「副顧問」或「Bridgewater」）提供的模型投資組合來投資基金資產，從而實現基金的投資目標。

info.description: Pono Capital Four, Inc. is a blank check company formed for the purpose of effecting a merger, amalgamation, share exchange, asset acquisition, share purchase, and reorganization with one or more businesses. The company was founded on January 2, 2026 and is headquartered in Grand Cayman, KY.
info.description_zh: Pono Capital Four, Inc. 是一家空白支票公司，其成立目的是與一個或多個企業進行合併、合併、股份交換、資產收購、股份購買和重組。該公司成立於2026年1月2日，總部位於肯塔基州大開曼島。

info.description: Sophus Capital Emerging Market ETF is an actively managed fund that seeks long-term capital appreciation by investing at least 80% of its net assets in equity securities-including common and preferred stock, depositary receipts (ADRs, GDRs, EDRs), and ETFs-issued by companies located in or tied economically to emerging and frontier markets. The investment strategy combines quantitative screening through a proprietary alpha model with fundamental research to build a diversified portfolio targeting companies across all market capitalizations positioned for sustainable earnings growth and positive earnings revisions at attractive valuations.
info.description_zh: Sophus Capital Emerging Market ETF 是一檔主動管理基金，透過將至少 80% 的淨資產投資於由位於新興和前沿市場或與新興和前沿市場經濟相關的公司發行的股本證券（包括普通股和優先股、存託憑證（ADR、GDR、EDR）和 ETF）來尋求長期資本增值。該投資策略將透過專有的阿爾法模型進行定量篩選與基礎研究相結合，建立一個多元化的投資組合，針對所有市值的公司，這些公司定位於可持續盈利增長，並以有吸引力的估值進行積極的盈利修正。

info.description: Graniteshares YieldBOOST Meta ETF seeks current income; exposure to the performance of one or more exchange-traded funds whose shares trade on a U.S.-regulated securities exchange and that seek daily leverage investment results of 2 times (200%) the daily percentage of the common stock of Meta Platforms, Inc. Class A (NASDAQ: META) subject to a limit on potential investment gains. The fund will invest at least 80% of its net assets (plus any borrowings for investment purposes) in derivatives contracts that utilize the Underlying META ETF as the reference asset. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: Graniteshares YieldBOOST Meta ETF 尋求當前收入；暴露於一隻或多只交易所交易基金的表現，這些基金的股票在美國監管的證券交易所進行交易，並且尋求每日槓桿投資結果為 Meta Platforms, Inc. A 類（納斯達克股票代碼：META）普通每日百分比的 2 倍（200%），但受到潛在投資收益股票的限制。該基金將至少 80% 的淨資產（加上任何用於投資目的的借款）投資於利用基礎 META ETF 作為參考資產的衍生性合約。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Vanguard Emerging Markets Government Bond Index Fund ETF Shares seeks to track the performance of the Bloomberg USD Emerging Markets Government RIC Capped Index that measures the investment return of U.S. dollar-denominated bonds issued by governments and government-related issuers in emerging market countries. The manager employs an indexing investment approach designed to track the performance of index. All of the fund's investments will be selected through the sampling process, and under normal circumstances at least 80% of the fund's assets will be invested in bonds included in the index. It is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: Vanguard Emerging Markets Government Bond Index Fund ETF Shares 旨在追蹤彭博美元新興市場政府 RIC 上限指數的表現，該指數衡量新興市場國家政府和政府相關發行人發行的美元計價債券的投資回報。管理人採用旨在追蹤指數表現的指數投資方法。基金的所有投資都會透過抽樣過程進行篩選，一般情況下基金資產的至少80%會投資於指數納入的債券。它是非多元化的。

info.description: Lafayette Digital Acquisition Corp. I operates as a blank check company. It was formed for the purpose of effecting a merger, capital stock exchange, asset acquisition, stock purchase, reorganization, or similar business combination with one or more businesses. The company was founded on August 5, 2025 and is headquartered in Miami, FL.
info.description_zh: Lafayette Digital Acquisition Corp. I 是一家空白支票公司。它的成立目的是與一個或多個企業進行合併、股本交換、資產收購、股票購買、重組或類似的業務合併。該公司成立於2025年8月5日，總部位於佛羅裡達州邁阿密。

info.description: First Trust Multi Cap Growth AlphaDEX Fund seeks investment results that correspond generally to the price and yield (before the fund's fees and expenses) of the Nasdaq AlphaDEX Multi Cap Growth Index. The fund will normally invest at least 90% of its net assets (including investment borrowings) in the common stocks that comprise the index. The index is designed to select growth stocks from the NASDAQ US 500 Large Cap Index TM, NASDAQ US 600 Mid Cap Index TM and NASDAQ US 700 Small Cap Index TM that may generate positive alpha, or risk-adjusted returns, relative to traditional indices through the use of the AlphaDEX selection methodology.
info.description_zh: First Trust Multi Cap Growth AlphaDEX 基金尋求與納斯達克 AlphaDEX Multi Cap Growth Index 的價格和收益率（未計基金費用和開支）相對應的投資結果。該基金通常將至少 90% 的淨資產（包括投資借款）投資於構成該指數的普通股。該指數旨在透過使用 AlphaDEX 選擇方法，從納斯達克美國 500 大型股指數 TM、納斯達克美國 600 中型股指數 TM 和納斯達克美國 700 小型股指數 TM 中選擇成長型股票，這些股票相對於傳統指數可能產生正的阿爾法或風險調整回報。

info.description: Global X NASDAQ 100 Covered Call ETF seeks to provide investment results that closely correspond, before fees and expenses, generally to the price and yield performance of the CBOE NASDAQ-100 BuyWrite V2 Index (the "underlying index"). The fund will invest at least 80% of its total assets in the securities of the underlying index. The CBOE NASDAQ-100 BuyWrite Index is a benchmark index that measures the performance of a theoretical portfolio that holds a portfolio of the stocks included in the NASDAQ-100 Index, and "writes" (or sells) a succession of one-month at-the-money NASDAQ-100 Index covered call options. It is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: Global X NASDAQ 100 備兌買權 ETF 力求提供在扣除費用和支出之前，通常與 CBOE NASDAQ-100 BuyWrite V2 指數（「基礎指數」）的價格和收益率表現密切對應的投資結果。該基金將至少80%的總資產投資於相關指數的證券。 CBOE NASDAQ-100 BuyWrite 指數是衡量理論投資組合表現的基準指數，該理論投資組合持有 NASDAQ-100 指數中包含的股票投資組合，並「賣出」（或賣出）一系列 1 個月平價 NASDAQ-100 指數擔保看漲期權。它是非多元化的。

info.description: SiTime Corp.is a micro-electromechanical system-based silicon timing solution. The company is transforming the timing industry with configurable solutions that replace legacy quartz devices and enable customers to differentiate their products with performance, smaller size, lower power, and reliability. The company was founded by Markus Lutz and Aaron Partridge on December 3, 2003 and is headquartered in Santa Clara, CA.
info.description_zh: SiTime Corp.是一家基於微機電系統的矽計時解決方案。該公司正在透過可配置的解決方案來改變計時行業，這些解決方案取代了傳統的石英裝置，並使客戶能夠憑藉性能、更小的尺寸、更低的功耗和可靠性來區分他們的產品。該公司由 Markus Lutz 和 Aaron Partridge 於 2003 年 12 月 3 日創立，總部位於加州聖克拉拉。

info.description: Netflix, Inc. engages in providing entertainment services. It also offers activities for leisure time, entertainment video, video gaming, and other sources of entertainment. It operates through the United States and International geographic segments. The company was founded by Marc Randolph and Wilmot Reed Hastings on August 29, 1997 and is headquartered in Los Gatos, CA.
info.description_zh: Netflix, Inc. 從事提供娛樂服務。它還提供休閒活動、娛樂影片、視頻遊戲和其他娛樂來源。它透過美國和國際地理部門開展業務。該公司由 Marc Randolph 和 Wilmot Reed Hastings 於 1997 年 8 月 29 日創立，總部位於加州洛斯加托斯。

info.description: Teradyne, Inc. engages in the development and sale of automatic test systems. It operates through the following business segments: Semiconductor Test, Robotics, and All Other. The Semiconductor Test segment designs, manufactures, and markets semiconductor test products and services. The Robotics segment includes operations related to the design, manufacturing, and marketing of collaborative robotic arms, autonomous mobile robots, and advanced robotic control software. The company was founded by Alexander V. d'Arbeloff and Nicholas DeWolf in 1960 and is headquartered in North Reading, MA.
info.description_zh: Teradyne, Inc. 從事自動測試系統的開發和銷售。它透過以下業務部門運作：半導體測試、機器人和所有其他業務。半導體測試部門設計、製造和銷售半導體測試產品和服務。機器人部門包括與協作機器人手臂、自主移動機器人和先進機器人控制軟體的設計、製造和行銷相關的業務。該公司由 Alexander V. d'Arbeloff 和 Nicholas DeWolf 於 1960 年創立，總部位於馬薩諸塞州北雷丁。

info.description: CoStar Group, Inc. engages in the provision of online real estate marketplaces, information, and analytics in the commercial and residential property markets. It operates through the following segments: CoStar Portfolio, Information Services Portfolio, Multifamily Portfolio, LoopNet Portfolio, and Other Marketplaces Portfolio. The CoStar Portfolio segment consists of two classes of trade receivables based on geographical location: North America and International. The Information Services Portfolio segment includes four classes of trade receivables: CoStar Real Estate Manager, Hospitality, North America, Hospitality, International, and other Information Services. The Multifamily Portfolio, LoopNet Portfolio, and Other Marketplaces Portfolio segments focus on one class of trade receivables. The company was founded by Andrew C. Florance and Michael R. Klein in 1987 and is headquartered in Arlington, VA.
info.description_zh: CoStar Group, Inc. 致力於在商業和住宅房地產市場提供線上房地產市場、資訊和分析。該公司透過以下部門營運：CoStar Portfolio、Information Services Portfolio、Multifamily Portfolio、LoopNet Portfolio 和 Other Marketplaces Portfolio。 CoStar Portfolio 部門根據地理位置由兩類貿易應收帳款組成：北美和國際。資訊服務組合部門包括四類貿易應收帳款：CoStar 房地產經理、飯店、北美、飯店、國際和其他資訊服務。多戶型投資組合、LoopNet 投資組合和其他市場投資組合細分市場則專注於一類貿易應收款。該公司由 Andrew C. Florance 和 Michael R. Klein 於 1987 年創立，總部位於維吉尼亞州阿靈頓。

info.description: FedEx Corp. is a holding company, which engages in the provision of transportation, e-commerce, and business services. It operates through the following segments: Federal Express, FedEx Freight, and FedEx Corporate and Other. The Federal Express segment provides transportation, delivery, and related logistics services for packages and freight worldwide. The FedEx Freight segment offers less-than-truckload (LTL) freight transportation services. The FedEx Corporate and Other segment includes corporate headquarters costs for executive officers and certain legal and finance functions, as well as certain other costs and credits not allocated to the company's transportation businesses. The company was founded by Frederick Wallace Smith on June 18, 1971, and is headquartered in Memphis, TN.
info.description_zh: 聯邦快遞公司是一家控股公司，從事提供運輸、電子商務和商業服務。它透過以下部門運作：聯邦快遞、聯邦快遞貨運、聯邦快遞企業及其他部門。聯邦快遞部門為全球包裹和貨運提供運輸、遞送和相關物流服務。聯邦快遞貨運部門提供零擔 (LTL) 貨運服務。聯邦快遞企業和其他部門包括公司總部執行官和某些法律和財務職能的成本，以及未分配給公司運輸業務的某些其他成本和信貸。該公司由 Frederick Wallace Smith 於 1971 年 6 月 18 日創立，總部位於田納西州孟菲斯。

info.description: GoDaddy, Inc. engages in the provision of simple and easy-to-use products on a single technology platform, complemented by personalized guidance. It operates through the following segments: Applications and Commerce (A&C) and Core Platform (Core). The Applications and Commerce (A&C) segment sells products containing proprietary software, commerce solutions, third-party email services, productivity tools, and certain products bundled with proprietary software offerings. The Core Platform (Core) segment provides domain registrations and renewals, aftermarket domain sales, website hosting services, website security products that are not included in bundled proprietary software offerings, and other products that do not contain a software component. The company was founded by Robert R. Parsons in 1997 and is headquartered in Tempe, AZ.
info.description_zh: GoDaddy, Inc. 致力於在單一技術平台上提供簡單易用的產品，並輔以個人化指導。它透過以下部門運作：應用程式和商務（A＆C）以及核心平台（Core）。應用程式和商務 (A&C) 部門銷售的產品包含專有軟體、商務解決方案、第三方電子郵件服務、生產力工具以及與專有軟體產品捆綁在一起的某些產品。核心平台（核心）部門提供網域名稱註冊和續約、售後網域銷售、網站寄存服務、不包含在捆綁專有軟體產品中的網站安全產品以及其他不包含軟體元件的產品。該公司由 Robert R. Parsons 於 1997 年創立，總部位於亞利桑那州坦佩。

info.description: The Hershey Co. engages in the manufacture and marketing of chocolate, sweets, mints and confectionery products. The firm operates through the following segments: North America Confectionery, North America Salty Snacks and International. The North America Confectionery segment is responsible for the traditional chocolate and non-chocolate confectionery market position of the company, as well as its grocery and snacks market positions, in the United States and Canada. The North America Salty Snacks segment is responsible for the salty snack products in the United States. The International segment includes the combination of all other operating segments, including those geographic regions where the company operates outside of North America. Its brands include Hershey's, Reese's, and Kisses. The company was founded by Milton S. Hershey in 1894 and is headquartered in Hershey, PA.
info.description_zh: 好時公司從事巧克力、糖果、薄荷糖和糖果產品的製造和行銷。該公司透過以下部門營運：北美糖果部門、北美鹹味零食部門和國際部門。北美糖果部門負責公司在美國和加拿大的傳統巧克力和非巧克力糖果市場地位，以及雜貨和零食市場地位。北美鹹味零食部門負責美國的鹹味零食產品。國際部門包括所有其他營運部門的組合，包括公司在北美以外營運的地理區域。其品牌包括 Hershey's、Reese's 和 Kisses。該公司由 Milton S. Hershey 於 1894 年創立，總部位於賓夕法尼亞州好時市。

info.description: Abony Acquisition Corp. I operates as a blank check company. It was formed for the purpose of effecting a merger, capital stock exchange, asset acquisition, stock purchase, reorganization, or similar business combination with one or more businesses. The company was founded on November 13, 2025 and is headquartered in Austin, TX.
info.description_zh: Abony Acquisition Corp. I 以空白支票公司經營。它的成立目的是與一個或多個企業進行合併、股本交換、資產收購、股票購買、重組或類似的業務合併。該公司成立於2025年11月13日，總部位於德克薩斯州奧斯汀。

info.description: Acrivon Therapeutics, Inc. develops drugs for clinical treatment. Its unique precision medicine platform is Acrivon Predictive Precision Proteomics (AP3). AP3 is used to generate proprietary OncoSignature companion diagnostics to identify patients who will benefit from the medicine. The company was founded by Peter Blume-Jensen and Kristina Masson in 2018 and is headquartered in Watertown, MA.
info.description_zh: Acrivon Therapeutics, Inc. 開發用於臨床治療的藥物。其獨特的精準醫學平台為 Acrivon Predictive Precision Proteomics (AP3)。 AP3 用於產生專有的 OncoSignature 伴隨診斷，以識別將從該藥物中受益的患者。該公司由 Peter Blume-Jensen 和 Kristina Masson 於 2018 年創立，總部位於馬薩諸塞州沃特敦。

info.description: Addex Therapeutics Ltd. is a biopharmaceutical company, which engages in the development of drugs for human health. It develops novel, orally available, and small molecule allosteric modulators for neurological disorders. Its pipeline includes Dipraglurant, ADX71149, GABAB PAM, mGlu7 NAM, mGlu2 NAM, mGlu4 PAM, and mGlu3 PAM. The company was founded by Vincent Mutel, Timothy Dyer, and Mark Epping-Jordan in 2002 and is headquartered in Geneva, Switzerland.
info.description_zh: Addex Therapeutics Ltd.是一家生物製藥公司，致力於人類健康藥物的開發。它開發用於神經系統疾病的新型口服小分子變構調節劑。其管道包括 Dipraglurant、ADX71149、GABAB PAM、mGlu7 NAM、mGlu2 NAM、mGlu4 PAM 和 mGlu3 PAM。該公司由 Vincent Mutel、Timothy Dyer 和 Mark Epping-Jordan 於 2002 年創立，總部位於瑞士日內瓦。

info.description: ARC Group Acquisition I Corp. is a blank check company. It was created for the purpose of effecting a merger, amalgamation, share exchange, asset acquisition, share purchase, reorganization or similar business combination. The company was founded on May 27, 2025, and is headquartered in Tempe, AZ.
info.description_zh: ARC Group Acquisition I Corp. 是一家空白支票公司。它的創建目的是為了實現合併、合併、股份交換、資產收購、股份購買、重組或類似的業務合併。該公司成立於2025年5月27日，總部位於亞利桑那州坦佩。

info.description: Assembly Biosciences, Inc. is a biotechnology company that focuses on developing small molecule antiviral therapeutics for serious viral diseases. Its lead programs, ABI-5366 and ABI-1179, long-acting helicase-primase inhibitors, are in clinical development for recurrent genital herpes. The company is partnered with Gilead Sciences to advance current and future antiviral programs across herpesviruses, HBV, and HDV. Assembly Biosciences was founded in 2005 and is headquartered in South San Francisco, CA.
info.description_zh: Assembly Biosciences, Inc. 是一家生物技術公司，專注於開發針對嚴重病毒性疾病的小分子抗病毒療法。其主導計畫 ABI-5366 和 ABI-1179 是長效解旋酶引子酶抑制劑，目前正處於治療復發性生殖器皰疹的臨床開發階段。該公司與吉利德科學公司合作，推動目前和未來的皰疹病毒、乙型肝炎病毒和丁型肝炎病毒的抗病毒計畫。 Assembly Biosciences 成立於 2005 年，總部位於加州南舊金山。

info.description: Leverage Shares 2X Long ASML Daily ETF seeks daily levered investment results, before fees and expenses, of two times (200%) of the daily percentage change in the price of ASML. The fund is an actively managed ETF. It invests at least 80% of its net assets (plus borrowings for investment purposes) in financial instruments with economic characteristics that, in combination, provide 200% daily leveraged exposure to ASML, consistent with the fund's investment objective. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: 槓桿股票 2 倍多頭 ASML 每日 ETF 尋求每日槓桿投資結果（未計費用和開支）為 ASML 價格每日百分比變化的兩倍 (200%)。該基金是主動式管理ETF。它將至少 80% 的淨資產（加上用於投資目的的借款）投資於具有經濟特徵的金融工具，這些金融工具組合起來為 ASML 提供 200% 的每日槓桿敞口，這與該基金的投資目標一致。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Atlanta Braves Holdings, Inc. owns and operates a Major League Baseball (MLB) club. It operates through the Baseball and Mixed-Use Development segments. The Baseball segment includes its operations relating to the Braves baseball franchise and Truist Park and includes revenue generated from ticket sales, concessions, local broadcasting rights, advertising sponsorships, suites, and premium seat fees, retail and licensing revenue, shared MLB revenue streams, including national broadcasting rights and licensing, and other sources. Ticket sales, concessions, broadcasting rights and advertising sponsorship sales are the baseball segment's primary revenue drivers. The Mixed-Use Development segment includes retail, office, hotel and entertainment operations within The Battery Atlanta. The Battery Atlanta derives revenue primarily from office and retail rental income including overage rent and tenant reimbursements and, to a lesser extent, parking and advertising sponsorships. The company was founded on December 7, 2022 and is headquartered in Atlanta, GA.
info.description_zh: 亞特蘭大勇士控股公司 (Atlanta Braves Holdings, Inc.) 擁有並經營美國職棒大聯盟 (MLB) 俱樂部。它透過棒球和混合用途開發部門運作。棒球部門包括與勇敢者棒球特許經營權和Truist Park相關的業務，包括門票銷售、特許權、當地廣播權、廣告贊助、套房和高級座位費、零售和許可收入、共享MLB收入流（包括國家廣播權和許可）以及其他來源產生的收入。門票銷售、優惠、轉播權和廣告贊助銷售是棒球業務的主要收入來源。混合用途開發部門包括亞特蘭大砲台內的零售、辦公室、飯店和娛樂業務。亞特蘭大砲台的收入主要來自辦公室和零售租金收入，包括超額租金和租戶報銷，以及較小程度的停車和廣告贊助。該公司成立於2022年12月7日，總部位於喬治亞州亞特蘭大。

info.description: iShares USD Green Bond ETF seeks to track the investment results of the Bloomberg MSCI USD Green Bond Select Index composed of U.S. dollar-denominated investment-grade green bonds that are issued by U.S. and non-U.S. issuers to fund environmental projects. The fund seeks to track the investment results of the underlying index, which measures the performance of U.S. dollar-denominated investment-grade green bonds issued by U.S. and non-U.S. issuers to fund projects with direct environmental benefits.
info.description_zh: iShares 美元綠色債券 ETF 旨在追蹤彭博 MSCI 美元綠色債券精選指數的投資結果，該指數由美國和非美國發行人發行的以美元計價的投資級綠色債券組成，為環保項目提供資金。該基金旨在追蹤基礎指數的投資結果，該指數衡量美國和非美國發行人為資助具有直接環境效益的項目而發行的以美元計價的投資級綠色債券的表現。

info.description: Bioceres Crop Solutions Corp. engages in the provision of crop productivity solutions. The firm includes seeds, seed traits, seed treatments, biologicals, high-value adjuvants and fertilizers. It operates through the following segments: Seed and Integrated Products, Crop Protection, and Crop Nutrition. The Seed and Integrated Products segment deals with the development and commercialization of integrated products that combine three complementary components biotechnological events, germplasm and seed treatments in order to increase crop productivity and create value for customers. The Crop Protection segment develops and produces adjuvants, insecticides and fungicides. The Crop Nutrition segment focuses on the development, production and commercialization of inoculants that allow the biological fixation of nitrogen in the crops and of fertilizers including bio fertilizers and micro granulated fertilizers that increases the productivity and yield of the crops. The company was founded on November 14, 2017 and is headquartered in Rosario, Argentina.
info.description_zh: Bioceres Crop Solutions Corp. 致力於提供作物生產力解決方案。該公司業務包括種子、種子性狀、種子處理劑、生物製品、高價值助劑和肥料。它透過以下部門運作：種子和綜合產品、作物保護和作物營養。種子和綜合產品部門致力於綜合產品的開發和商業化，這些產品結合了三個互補的生物技術事件、種質和種子處理，以提高作物生產力並為客戶創造價值。作物保護部門開發生產助劑、殺蟲劑和殺菌劑。作物營養部門專注於接種劑的開發、生產和商業化，這些接種劑可以對作物中的氮進行生物固定，以及肥料（包括生物肥料和微顆粒肥料）的開發、生產和商業化，以提高作物的生產力和產量。該公司成立於2017年11月14日，總部位於阿根廷羅薩裡奧。

info.description: BNY Mellon Municipal Intermediate ETF is an actively managed fund that seeks to maximize current income exempt from federal income tax while prioritizing capital preservation. The strategy primarily targets investment-grademunicipal bonds with an intermediate-term profile, generally maintaining an average effective portfolio duration between three and eight years.
info.description_zh: 紐約梅隆市政中級 ETF 是一隻積極管理的基金，旨在最大限度地提高當前免繳聯邦所得稅的收入，同時優先考慮資本保值。該策略主要針對具有中期特徵的投資等級市政債券，通常將平均有效投資期間維持在三到八年之間。

info.description: Leverage Shares 2X Long BLSH Daily ETF seeks daily levered investment results, before fees and expenses, of two times (200%) of the daily percentage change in the price of the common stock of BLSH. The fund invests at least 80% of its net assets (plus borrowings for investment purposes) in the underlying security and financial instruments with economic characteristics that, in combination, provide 200% daily leveraged exposure to the price of the underlying security, consistent with the fund's investment objective. It is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: 槓桿股票 2 倍多頭 BLSH 每日 ETF 尋求 BLSH 普通股價格每日百分比變化兩倍 (200%) 的每日槓桿投資結果（扣除費用和開支）。該基金將至少 80% 的淨資產（加上用於投資目的的借款）投資於標的證券和具有經濟特徵的金融工具，這些證券和金融工具結合起來提供標的證券價格的 200% 每日槓桿敞口，與基金的投資目標一致。它是非多元化的。

info.description: CAMP4 Therapeutics Corp. is a clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company, which engages in the discovery and development of a class of RNA-targeting therapeutics for upregulating gene expression and restoration of healthy protein levels to treat a broad range of genetic diseases. Its lead product candidate is CMP-002. The company was founded by Richard A. Young and Leonard Zon in 2015 and is headquartered in Cambridge, MA.
info.description_zh: CAMP4 Therapeutics Corp. 是一家臨床階段的生物製藥公司，致力於發現和開發一類 RNA 標靶療法，用於上調基因表現和恢復健康蛋白質水平，以治療多種遺傳疾病。其主要候選產品為 CMP-002。該公司由 Richard A. Young 和 Leonard Zon 於 2015 年創立，總部位於馬薩諸塞州劍橋。

info.description: Cerus Corp. engages in the research, development, and manufacturing of biomedical and surgical products. The firm produces blood system for platelets and plasma. It operates through Blood Safety segment. It markets products under the INTERCEPT brand. The company was founded by Laurence M. Corash and John E. Hearst on September 19, 1991 and is headquartered in Concord, CA.
info.description_zh: Cerus Corp. 從事生物醫學和外科產品的研究、開發和製造。該公司生產血小板和血漿的血液系統。它透過血液安全部門運作。它以 INTERCEPT 品牌銷售產品。該公司由 Laurence M. Corash 和 John E. Hearst 於 1991 年 9 月 19 日創立，總部位於加州康科德。

info.description: Calamos Global Dynamic Income Fund is a closed ended balanced mutual fund launched by Calamos Investments LLC. The fund is managed by Calamos Advisors LLC. It invests in public equity and fixed income markets across the globe. The fund seeks to invest in securities of companies operating across diversified sectors. It primarily invests in growth stocks of companies across all market capitalizations, as well as in higher yield corporate bonds, government bonds, convertibles, and alternative investments such as arbitrage and call writes. The fund employs both fundamental and quantitative analysis, focusing on such factors as source, sustainability, and risk of investment opportunities to create its portfolio. It benchmarks the performance of its portfolio against the MSCI World Index and Merrill Lynch Global Broad Markets Index. The fund was formerly known as Calamos Global Diversified Income & Opportunities Fund. Calamos Global Dynamic Income Fund was formed on April 10, 2007 and is domiciled in the United States.
info.description_zh: Calamos 全球動態收入基金是 Calamos Investments LLC 推出的封閉式平衡共同基金。該基金由 Calamos Advisors LLC 管理。它投資於全球公共股權和固定收益市場。該基金尋求投資於多元化產業運營的公司的證券。它主要投資於所有市值公司的成長型股票，以及較高收益的公司債、政府公債、可轉換債券以及套利和買權等另類投資。本基金採用基本面分析和定量分析，重點在於投資機會的來源、永續性和風險等因素來創建投資組合。它將其投資組合的表現與摩根士丹利資本國際世界指數和美林全球廣泛市場指數進行比較。該基金以前稱為卡拉莫斯全球多元化收入和機會基金。 Calamos 全球動態收入基金成立於 2007 年 4 月 10 日，註冊地為美國。

info.description: Connect Biopharma Holdings Ltd. operates as clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company. It focuses on advancing rademikibart, an anti-interleukin-4-receptor alpha antibody, to transform acute and chronic care in asthma and chronic obstructive pulmonary disease. The company was founded by Zheng Wei and Wu Bin Pan on November 23, 2015 and is headquartered in San Diego, CA.
info.description_zh: Connect Biopharma Holdings Ltd. 是一家臨床階段的生物製藥公司。它專注於推進 rademikibart（一種抗白細胞介素 4 受體 α 抗體）的發展，以改變氣喘和慢性阻塞性肺病的急性和慢性護理。該公司由鄭偉和潘吳斌於2015年11月23日創立，總部位於加州聖地牙哥。

info.description: CorMedix, Inc. is a pharmaceutical and medical device company, which engages in the development and commercialization of therapeutic products for the prevention and treatment of diseases and conditions. The company was founded by Antony E. Pfaffle on July 28, 2006 and is headquartered in Berkeley Heights, NJ.
info.description_zh: CorMedix, Inc.是一家製藥和醫療器材公司，致力於預防和治療疾病和病症的治療產品的開發和商業化。該公司由 Antony E. Pfaffle 於 2006 年 7 月 28 日創立，總部位於新澤西州 Berkeley Heights。

info.description: Castor Maritime, Inc. engages in the provision of shipping transportation services. It operates through the following segments: Dry Bulk, Containership, and Asset Management. The Dry Bulk segment provides dry bulk commodities transportation services. The Containership segment provides cargo transportation services. The Asset Management segment focuses on the activities of the subsidiary MPC Capital, an internationally active manager and provider of services for investment projects in maritime and energy infrastructure. The company was founded by Petros Panagiotidis on September 12, 2017 and is headquartered in Limassol, Cyprus.
info.description_zh: Castor Maritime, Inc. 從事提供船舶運輸服務。它透過以下部門運作：幹散貨部門、貨櫃船部門和資產管理部門。乾散貨部門提供乾散貨商品運輸服務。貨櫃船部門提供貨物運輸服務。資產管理部門專注於子公司 MPC Capital 的活動，該公司是一家國際活躍的海事和能源基礎設施投資專案管理人和服務提供者。該公司由Petros Panagiotidis於2017年9月12日創立，總部位於塞浦路斯利馬索爾。

info.description: D. Boral Acquisition I Corp. operates as a blank check company. It was formed for the purpose of effecting a merger, capital stock exchange, asset acquisition, stock purchase, reorganization, or similar business combination with one or more businesses. The company was founded on April 3, 2025 and is headquartered in New York, NY.
info.description_zh: D. Boral Acquisition I Corp. 以空白支票公司經營。它的成立目的是與一個或多個企業進行合併、股本交換、資產收購、股票購買、重組或類似的業務合併。該公司成立於2025年4月3日，總部位於紐約州紐約。

info.description: Dolphin Entertainment, Inc. engages in the provision of entertainment marketing and content development. It operates through the following segments: Entertainment Publicity and Marketing, and Content Production. The Entertainment Publicity and Marketing segment consists of 42West, The Door, Elle, Digital Department, Special Projects, and Shore Fire Media. The Content Production segment consists of Dolphin Films and a department within Dolphin which develops, produces, and distributes feature films, television and digital content. The company was founded on March 7, 1995 and is headquartered in Coral Gables, FL.
info.description_zh: Dolphin Entertainment, Inc. 從事提供娛樂行銷和內容開發。它透過以下部門運作：娛樂宣傳和行銷以及內容製作。娛樂宣傳和行銷部門由 42West、The Door、Elle、數位部門、Special Projects 和 Shore Fire Media 組成。內容製作部門由 Dolphin Films 和 Dolphin 內負責開發、製作和發行長片、電視和數位內容的部門組成。該公司成立於1995年3月7日，總部位於佛羅裡達州科勒爾蓋布爾斯。

info.description: iShares J.P. Morgan USD Emerging Markets Bond ETF seeks to track the investment results of the J.P. Morgan EMBI Global Core Index composed of U.S. dollar-denominated, emerging market bonds. The fund will invest at least 80% of its assets in the component securities of the underlying index and will invest at least 90% of its assets in fixed income securities of the types included in the underlying index. The index is a broad, diverse U.S. dollar-denominated emerging markets debt benchmark that tracks the total return of actively traded external debt instruments in emerging market countries.
info.description_zh: iShares 摩根大通美元新興市場債券 ETF 旨在追蹤由以美元計價的新興市場債券組成的摩根大通 EMBI 全球核心指數的投資結果。該基金將至少 80% 的資產投資於基礎指數的組成證券，並將至少 90% 的資產投資於基礎指數所包含類型的固定收益證券。該指數是一個廣泛、多樣化的以美元計價的新興市場債務基準，追蹤新興市場國家交易活躍的外債工具的總回報。

info.description: Figure Technology Solutions, Inc. is a blockchain-native capital marketplace, which engages in connecting origination, funding, and secondary market activity. It operates through the following segments: FTI, Markets, and Other. The FTI segment offers Figure Connect which generates ecosystem and technology fees, and originates, sells, and securitizes home equity line of credit (HELOC) loans that it services. The Markets segment utilizes blockchain technology to develop an exchange for digital assets and credit, with new product offerings including providing interest-bearing stable coin deposits. The company was founded by Michael Scott Cagney and June Ou in 2018 and is headquartered in Reno, NV.
info.description_zh: Figure Technology Solutions, Inc. 是一個區塊鏈原生資本市場，致力於連結發起、融資和二級市場活動。它透過以下部門運作：FTI、市場和其他部門。 FTI 部門提供Figure Connect，該產品產生生態系統和技術費用，並發起、銷售和證券化其服務的房屋淨值信貸額度 (HELOC) 貸款。市場部門利用區塊鏈技術開發數位資產和信用交易，提供新產品，包括提供計息穩定幣存款。該公司由 Michael Scott Cagney 和 June Ou 於 2018 年創立，總部位於內華達州里諾。

info.description: JFrog Ltd. engages in the provision of an end-to-end, hybrid, universal development operations platform that powers and controls the software supply chain, which enables organizations to continuously and securely deliver software updates across any system. The firm operates through the following geographical segments: United States, Israel, India, and Rest of World. It is also involved in creating software delivered without friction from developer to device. The company was founded by Frederic Simon, Shlomi Ben Haim, and Yoav Landman in 2008 and is headquartered in Sunnyvale, CA.
info.description_zh: JFrog Ltd. 致力於提供端到端、混合、通用的開發營運平台，該平台支援和控制軟體供應鏈，使組織能夠在任何系統上持續、安全地交付軟體更新。該公司透過以下地理區域開展業務：美國、以色列、印度和世界其他地區。它還參與創建從開發人員到設備之間無摩擦交付的軟體。該公司由 Frederic Simon、Shlomi Ben Haim 和 Yoav Landman 於 2008 年創立，總部位於加州桑尼維爾。

info.description: First Trust BuyWrite Income ETF seeks current income; capital appreciation is a secondary objective. The fund will pursue its objectives by investing primarily in equity securities listed on U.S. exchanges and by utilizing an "option strategy" consisting of writing (selling) U.S. exchange-traded call options on the Standard & Poor's 500 Index (the "index"). The call options written by the fund will be a laddered portfolio of call options with expirations of less than one year, written at-the-money to slightly out-of-the-money.
info.description_zh: First Trust BuyWrite Income ETF 尋求當前收益；資本增值是次要目標。該基金將透過主要投資於美國交易所上市的股票證券並利用「選擇權策略」來實現其目標，該策略包括賣出（出售）標準普爾 500 指數（「指數」）的美國交易所交易看漲期權。該基金賣出的買權將是到期日不到一年的階梯式買權投資組合，賣出選擇權為平價至輕微虛值。

info.description: Grocery Outlet Holding Corp. engages in the operation of retail stores in the United States. It offers name-brand consumables and fresh products through a network of independently operated stores. The company was founded by Jim Read in 1946 and is headquartered in Emeryville, CA.
info.description_zh: Grocery Outlet Holding Corp. 在美國從事零售店經營。它透過獨立經營的商店網路提供名牌消費品和新鮮產品。該公司由 Jim Read 於 1946 年創立，總部位於加州埃默里維爾。

info.description: Goldman Sachs Nasdaq-100 Core Premium Income ETF seeks current income while maintaining prospects for capital appreciation. The fund invests, under normal circumstances, at least 80% of its net assets plus any borrowings for investment purposes in equity investments of companies that are included in the fund's benchmark. The fund will generally seek to maintain style, capitalization and industry characteristics similar to its benchmark. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: 高盛 Nasdaq-100 核心溢價收入 ETF 尋求當前收入，同時維持資本增值前景。在正常情況下，該基金將至少80%的淨資產加上任何用於投資目的的借款投資於納入該基金基準的公司的股權投資。該基金通常會尋求保持與其基準相似的風格、資本規模和行業特徵。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Hennessy Capital Investment Corp. VIII is a blank check company. The firm was formed for the purpose of effecting a merger, share exchange, asset acquisition, share purchase, reorganization or similar business combination with one or more businesses. The company was founded on July 15, 2025 and is headquartered in Zephyr Cove, NV.
info.description_zh: Hennessy Capital Investment Corp. VIII 是一家空白支票公司。該公司的成立目的是與一個或多個企業進行合併、股份交換、資產收購、股份購買、重組或類似的業務合併。該公司成立於 2025 年 7 月 15 日，總部位於內華達州 Zephyr Cove。

info.description: Harmonic, Inc. engages in the development and sale of video delivery software, products, system solutions, and services. It operates through the Video and Broadband segments. The Video segment sells video processing and production and playout services to cable operators, satellite and telecommunications pay-TV service providers, and broadcast and media companies. The Broadband segment offers solutions to cable operators broadband access solutions and related services, including cOS software-based broadband access solution, to broadband operators globally. The company was founded in June 1988 and is headquartered in San Jose, CA.
info.description_zh: Harmonic, Inc. 從事視訊傳輸軟體、產品、系統解決方案和服務的開發和銷售。它透過視訊和寬頻部門運作。 The Video segment sells video processing and production and playout services to cable operators, satellite and telecommunications pay-TV service providers, and broadcast and media companies. The Broadway segment accers solutions toelmoc​​ion sar​​st the grautionsirutions 比這software-based broadband access solution, to broadband operators globally.該公司成立於 1988 年 6 月，總部位於加州聖荷西。

info.description: First Trust Dorsey Wright International Focus 5 ETF seeks investment results that correspond generally to the price and yield (before fees and expenses) of an index called the Dorsey Wright International Focus Five TM Index. The fund will normally invest at least 90% of its net assets (including investment borrowings) in the ETFs that comprise the index. The index is designed to provide targeted exposure to the five First Trust country/region-based ETFs that the index provider believes offer the greatest potential to outperform the other ETFs in the selection universe.
info.description_zh: First Trust Dorsey Wright International Focus 5 ETF 尋求與稱為 Dorsey Wright International Focus Five TM 指數的指數的價格和收益率（未計費用和開支）相對應的投資結果。該基金通常將至少 90% 的淨資產（包括投資借款）投資於構成該指數的 ETF。該指數旨在提供對 First Trust 五個基於國家/地區的 ETF 的有針對性的投資，指數提供者認為這些 ETF 具有超越精選範圍內其他 ETF 的最大潛力。

info.description: indie Semiconductor, Inc. is an autotech company, which engages in the provision of automotive semiconductor and software solutions for Advanced Driver Assistance Systems (ADAS), driver automation, in-cabin, user experience, and electrification applications. It also focuses on edge sensors across multiple modalities spanning light detection and ranging, radar, ultrasound, and computer vision. The company was founded by Donald Kenneth McClymont, Ichiro Aoki, Scott Kee, and David Kang on February 9, 2007 and is headquartered in Aliso Viejo, CA.
info.description_zh: indie Semiconductor, Inc. 是一家汽車技術公司，致力於為高級駕駛員輔助系統 (ADAS)、駕駛員自動化、車內、用戶體驗和電氣化應用提供汽車半導體和軟體解決方案。它還專注於跨光檢測和測距、雷達、超音波和電腦視覺等多種模式的邊緣感測器。該公司由 Donald Kenneth McClymont、Ichiro Aoki、Scott Kee 和 David Kang 於 2007 年 2 月 9 日創立，總部位於加州亞里索維耶荷。

info.description: Inovio Pharmaceuticals, Inc. engages in the provision of designed DNA medicines to treat and protect people from infectious diseases, cancer, and diseases associated with human papillomavirus. Its product pipeline includes VGX-3100, INO-3107, INO-5410, INO-4800, and PENNVAX-GP. The company was founded by David B. Weiner on June 29, 1983 and is headquartered in Plymouth Meeting, PA.
info.description_zh: Inovio Pharmaceuticals, Inc. 致力于提供设计的 DNA 药物，用于治疗和保护人们免受传染病、癌症以及与人乳头瘤病毒相关的疾病。其產品線包括VGX-3100、INO-3107、INO-5410、INO-4800和PENNVAX-GP。該公司由 David B. Weiner 於 1983 年 6 月 29 日創立，總部位於賓夕法尼亞州普利茅斯米廷。

info.description: ProShares Nasdaq-100 High Income ETF seeks investment results, before fees and expenses, that track the performance of the Nasdaq-100 Daily Covered Call Index. The index is designed to replicate the performance of an investment strategy that combines a long position in the Nasdaq-100 Index with a short position in Nasdaq-100 Index call options. Under normal circumstances, the fund will invest at least 80% of its total assets in component securities of the index or in instruments with similar economic characteristics. The fund is non-diversified. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: ProShares Nasdaq-100 高收入 ETF 尋求在費用和支出之前追蹤 Nasdaq-100 每日備兌買權指數表現的投資結果。該指數旨在複製將納斯達克 100 指數多頭頭寸與納斯達克 100 指數看漲期權空頭頭寸相結合的投資策略的績效。一般情況下，基金將至少80%的總資產投資於指數的組成證券或具有類似經濟特徵的工具。該基金是非多元化的。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: IREN Ltd. is a vertically integrated data center business powering the future of Bitcoin, AI and beyond with renewable energy. It is strategically located in renewable-rich, fiber-connected regions across the US and Canada. IREN's large-scale, grid-connected facilities are purpose-built for the next generation of power-dense computing applications. The company was founded by Daniel Roberts and William Roberts on November 6, 2018, and is headquartered in Sydney, Australia.
info.description_zh: IREN Ltd. 是一家垂直整合的資料中心企業，透過再生能源為比特幣、人工智慧及其他領域的未來提供動力。它地理位置優越，位於美國和加拿大可再生能源豐富、光纖連接的地區。 IREN 的大型併網設施專為新一代功率密集運算應用而建置。該公司由丹尼爾·羅伯茨和威廉·羅伯茨於2018年11月6日創立，總部位於澳洲雪梨。

info.description: Isabella Bank Corp. is a holding company, which engages in the provision of financial services through its subsidiary. It offers checking accounts, savings accounts, certificates of deposit, direct deposits, cash management services, mobile and internet banking, electronic bill pay services, and automated teller machines. It operates through the following segments: Commercial, Agricultural, Residential Real Estate, and Consumer. The company was founded in 1903 and is headquartered in Mount Pleasant, MI.
info.description_zh: 伊莎貝拉銀行公司是一家控股公司，透過其子公司提供金融服務。它提供支票帳戶、儲蓄帳戶、存款證、直接存款、現金管理服務、行動和網路銀行、電子帳單支付服務和自動櫃員機。它透過以下部門運作：商業部門、農業部門、住宅房地產部門和消費者部門。該公司成立於 1903 年，總部位於密西根州芒特普萊森特。

info.description: Kolibri Global Energy, Inc. is an international energy company, which focuses on finding and exploiting energy projects in oil, gas, and clean energy. It operates through the United States, and Canada and Other geographical segments. The company was founded on May 26, 2008 and is headquartered in Newbury Park, CA.
info.industry_zh: 石油和天然氣勘探與生產
info.description_zh: Kolibri Global Energy, Inc.是一家國際能源公司，專注於尋找和開發石油、天然氣和清潔能源領域的能源專案。它透過美國、加拿大和其他地理部門開展業務。該公司成立於2008年5月26日，總部位於加州紐伯里公園。

info.description: SEALSQ Corp. is a holding company, which engages in the security of microcontrollers. It operates through the following geographical segments: North America, Europe, Middle East, Africa, Asia Pacific, and Latin America. It focuses on authentication process, digital certification, and covering individual patents of semiconductors. The company was founded on April 1, 2022 and is headquartered in Cointrin, Switzerland.
info.description_zh: SEALSQ Corp. 是一家控股公司，從事微控制器安全業務。它透過以下地理區域開展業務：北美、歐洲、中東、非洲、亞太地區和拉丁美洲。它專注於認證過程、數位認證，並涵蓋半導體的個人專利。該公司成立於2022年4月1日，總部位於瑞士科因特林。

info.description: Lexaria Bioscience Corp. is a biotechnology company, which engages in the provision of active pharmaceutical ingredients through its DehydraTECH drug delivery technology. It operates through the IP licensing segment which generates revenue from customers by licensing its proprietary DehydraTECH technology. The company was founded on December 9, 2004 and is headquartered in Kelowna, Canada.
info.description_zh: Lexaria Bioscience Corp. 是一家生技公司，透過其 DeHydraTECH 藥物傳輸技術提供活性藥物成分。該公司透過 IP 授權部門運營，透過授權其專有的 DeHydraTECH 技術向客戶產生收入。該公司成立於2004年12月9日，總部位於加拿大基洛納。

info.description: Manzil Russell Halal USA Broad Market ETF seeks to track the total return performance, before fees and expenses, of the Russell IdealRatings Manzil Halal USA Broad Market Custom Index. The fund uses a "passive management" approach to track the performance of the index. The index is composed of the common stock of large capitalization U.S. companies. The index is constructed by evaluating the components of the index, using the Russell IdealRatings system, to identify companies that comply with Shariah principles. These ratings were developed based on the AAOFI. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: Manzil Russell Halal USA Broad Market ETF 旨在追蹤 Russell IdealRatings Manzil Halal USA Broad Market Custom Index 扣除費用和開支之前的總回報表現。該基金採用「被動管理」的方式來追蹤指數的表現。該指數由大型美國公司的普通股組成。該指數是透過使用 Russell IdealRatings 系統評估該指數的組成部分來建構的，以識別符合伊斯蘭教法原則的公司。這些評級是根據 AAOFI 制定的。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Muzero Acquisition Corp. operates as a blank check company. It was formed for the purpose of effecting a merger, amalgamation, share exchange, asset acquisition, share purchase, reorganization or similar business combination with one or more businesses. The company was founded on October 10, 2025 and is headquartered in New York, NY.
info.description_zh: Muzero Acquisition Corp. 作為一家空白支票公司運作。它的成立目的是與一個或多個企業進行合併、合併、股份交換、資產收購、股份購買、重組或類似的業務合併。該公司成立於2025年10月10日，總部位於紐約州紐約。

info.description: SPDR SSGA My2030 Corporate Bond ETF seeks to maximize current income while seeking preservation of capital. Under normal circumstances, SSGA Funds Management, Inc. invests at least 80% of the fund's net assets (plus borrowings for investment purposes) in corporate bonds. The fund primarily invests in corporate bonds maturing in the year 2030, which may include bonds with embedded issuer call options falling within that year. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: SPDR SSGA My2030 公司債 ETF 力求在尋求資本保全的同時實現當前收入最大化。在正常情況下，SSGA Funds Management, Inc.將至少80%的基金淨資產（加上投資目的借款）投資於公司債。該基金主要投資於2030年到期的公司債，其中可能包括嵌入發行人買權的債券。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Direxion Daily NFLX Bull 2X Shares seeks daily investment results, before fees and expenses, of 200% of the daily performance of NFLX. The fund, under normal circumstances, invests at least 80% of its net assets (plus any borrowings for investment purposes) in the securities of NFLX and financial instruments, such as swap agreements and options, that, in combination, provide 2X daily leveraged exposure to NFLX, consistent with the fund's investment objective. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: Direxion Daily NFLX Bull 2X Shares 寻求 NFLX 每日业绩的 200% 的每日投资结果（扣除费用和开支）。在正常情況下，該基金將至少 80% 的淨資產（加上任何用於投資目的的借款）投資於 NFLX 的證券和金融工具，例如掉期協議和選擇權，這些組合起來為 NFLX 提供 2 倍的每日槓桿敞口，這與基金的投資目標一致。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Eightco Holdings, Inc. operates as a universal foundation to invest in the transformative technologies shaping the future of humanity. The firm sits at the intersection of blockchain infrastructure, artificial intelligence, and next-generation consumer platforms. The company was founded in 1966 and is headquartered in Easton, PA.
info.description_zh: Evenco Holdings, Inc. 是一個投資塑造人類未來的變革性技術的全球基金會。該公司位於區塊鏈基礎設施、人工智慧和下一代消費者平台的交叉點。該公司成立於 1966 年，總部位於賓夕法尼亞州伊斯頓。

info.description: Ovid Therapeutics, Inc. is a biopharmaceutical company dedicated to pioneering better, gentler medicines for the brain. It discovers and develops differentiated, small molecule medicines for neurological and neuropsychiatric disorders with significant unmet need. The company was founded by Matthew During and Jeremy M. Levin on April 1, 2014 and is headquartered in New York, NY.
info.description_zh: Ovid Therapeutics, Inc. 是一家生物製藥公司，致力於開發更好、更溫和的大腦藥物。它發現和開發差異化的小分子藥物，用於治療尚未滿足重大需求的神經系統和神經精神疾病。該公司由 Matthew Dur 和 Jeremy M. Levin 於 2014 年 4 月 1 日創立，總部位於紐約州紐約市。

info.description: Patria Investments Ltd. engages in the provision of asset management. Its businesses include private equity, infrastructure, real estate, and credit. The company was founded in 2001 and is headquartered in George Town, Cayman Islands.
info.description_zh: Patria Investments Ltd. 從事提供資產管理業務。其業務包括私募股權、基礎設施、房地產和信貸。該公司成立於2001年，總部位於開曼群島喬治城。

info.description: Peace Acquisition Corp. is a blank check company, which engages in the purpose of effecting a merger, capital stock exchange, asset acquisition, stock purchase, reorganization, or similar business combination with one or more businesses. The company was founded on June 24, 2025 and is headquartered in New York, NY.
info.description_zh: Peace Acquisition Corp. 是一家空白支票公司，其目的是與一個或多個企業進行合併、股本交換、資產收購、股票購買、重組或類似業務合併。該公司成立於2025年6月24日，總部位於紐約州紐約。

info.description: YieldMax Nasdaq 100 0DTE Covered Call Strategy ETF seeks current income; the fund's secondary objective being capital appreciation. The fund seeks to achieve its investment objective by employing a synthetic covered call strategy, designed to generate current income on a weekly basis while also providing exposure to the price return of the Nasdaq 100 Index. In executing this strategy, the manager will utilize call options that reference the Index or on passively managed ETFs that seek to track the index's performance ("index ETFs"). The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: YieldMax Nasdaq 100 0DTE 備兌買權策略 ETF 尋求當前收益；該基金的次要目標是資本增值。該基金尋求透過採用綜合備兌買權策略來實現其投資目標，該策略旨在每週產生當前收入，同時還提供納斯達克 100 指數價格回報的曝險。在執行該策略時，管理人將利用參考指數或尋求追蹤指數表現的被動管理 ETF（「指數 ETF」）的看漲選擇權。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: First Trust NASDAQ-100-Technology Sector Index Fund seeks investment results that correspond generally to the price and yield (before the fund's fees and expenses) of an equity index called the NASDAQ-100 Technology Sector TM Index. The fund will normally invest at least 90% of its net assets (including investment borrowings) in the securities that comprise the index. The index is an equal-weighted index composed of the securities comprising the NASDAQ-100 Index that are classified as "technology" according to the Industry Classification Benchmark classification system.
info.description_zh: First Trust NASDAQ-100-Technology Sector Index Fund 尋求的投資結果通常與稱為 NASDAQ-100 Technology Sector TM Index 的股票指數的價格和收益率（在基金費用和開支之前）相對應。該基金通常將至少 90% 的淨資產（包括投資借款）投資於構成該指數的證券。該指數是一個等權重指數，由納斯達克 100 指數中根據行業分類基準分類系統歸類為「科技」的證券組成。

info.description: Radware Ltd. engages in the provision of application security and delivery solutions for multi-cloud environments. The company's cloud application, infrastructure, and API security solutions use AI-driven algorithms for precise, hands-free, real-time protection from the most sophisticated web, application, and DDoS attacks, API abuse, and bad bots. It operates through the following segments: Radware's Core Business and Hawks' Business. The Radware's Core Business segment engages in providing cloud security-as-a-service products, application and data center security solutions, and application availability services. The Hawks' Business segment provides cloud security solutions, including threat detection, entitlement management, and posture management. The company was founded by Yehuda Zisapel and Roy Zisapel on May 16, 1996 and is headquartered in Tel Aviv, Israel.
info.description_zh: Error 500 (Server Error)!!1500.That’s an error.There was an error. Please try again later.That’s all we know.

info.description: Intelligent Real Estate ETF seeks total return. The fund is an actively-managed exchange-traded fund ("ETF") that will invest in a diversified portfolio of publicly-traded real estate investment trusts ("REITs") and mortgage-backed securities ("MBS") listed primarily on U.S. stock exchanges, and to a lesser extent, stock exchanges in Canada, Europe, and Asia. The fund will invest in REITs and MBS that, in the determination of the fund's sub-adviser, have similar qualitative characteristics to the aggregate real estate portfolio holdings of a select group of public, non-traded REITs. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: 智慧房地產ETF追求總回報。該基金是一檔主動管理的交易所交易基金（「ETF」），將投資於主要在美國證券交易所上市的公開交易房地產投資信託基金（「REIT」）和抵押貸款支持證券（「MBS」）的多元化投資組合，其次是在加拿大、歐洲和亞洲的證券交易所上市。該基金將投資於基金副顧問確定的房地產投資信託基金和抵押貸款支持證券，這些房地產投資信託基金和抵押貸款支持證券與選定的一組公共非交易房地產投資信託基金的總房地產投資組合持有量具有相似的品質特徵。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Social Commerce Partners Corp. is a blank check company, which engages in the purpose of effecting a merger, amalgamation, share exchange, asset acquisition, share purchase, reorganization or similar business combination with one or more businesses. The company was founded on August 11, 2025 and is headquartered in Plano, TX.
info.description_zh: Social Commerce Partners Corp. 是一家空白支票公司，其目的是與一個或多個企業進行合併、合併、股份交換、資產收購、股份購買、重組或類似業務合併。該公司成立於2025年8月11日，總部位於德克薩斯州普萊諾。

info.description: 374Water, Inc. is a clean technology company. It offers supercritical water oxidation (SWCO) waste processors. It caters to municipal and industrial wastewater treatment plants, food waste, chemical plants, and army camps and emergency situations. The company was founded by Yaacov Nagar and Marc Deshusses on September 8, 2005 and is headquartered in Morrisville, NC.
info.description_zh: 374Water, Inc. 是一家清潔技術公司。它提供超臨界水氧化（SWCO）廢物處理器。它適用於市政和工業廢水處理廠、食物垃圾、化工廠、軍營和緊急情況。該公司由 Yaacov Nagar 和 Marc Deshusses 於 2005 年 9 月 8 日創立，總部位於北卡羅來納州莫里斯維爾。

info.description: SEI Select Emerging Markets Equity ETF seeks long-term capital appreciation. Under normal circumstances, the fund will invest at least 80% of its net assets (plus the amount of any borrowings for investment purposes) in equity securities of emerging market issuers. The fund normally maintains investments in at least six emerging market countries, however, it may invest a substantial amount of its assets in issuers located in a single country or a limited number of countries.
info.description_zh: SEI Select 新興市場股票 ETF 尋求長期資本增值。在正常情況下，該基金將至少80%的淨資產（加上任何用於投資目的的借款金額）投資於新興市場發行人的股本證券。該基金通常在至少六個新興市場國家進行投資，但也可能將大量資產投資於位於單一國家或有限數量國家的發行人。

info.description: SharonAI Holdings, Inc. operates as a holding company that develops and delivers GPU cloud computing and AI solutions. The company was founded on December 30, 2024 and is headquartered in New York, NY.
info.description_zh: SharonAI Holdings, Inc. 作為一家控股公司經營，開發和提供 GPU 雲端運算和人工智慧解決方案。該公司成立於2024年12月30日，總部位於紐約州紐約。

info.description: Hennessy Stance ESG ETF seeks to achieve long-term capital appreciation. The fund is an actively managed exchange-traded fund ("ETF") that will invest, under normal circumstances at least 80% of the value of its net assets plus the amount of any borrowings for investment purposes in exchange-traded equity securities of U.S. issuers that meet environmental, social, and governance ("ESG") standards, as determined by its sub-adviser.
info.description_zh: Hennessy Stance ESG ETF 尋求長期資本增值。該基金是一檔主動管理的交易所交易基金（「ETF」），在正常情況下，將至少將其淨資產價值的 80% 加上用於投資目的的任何借款金額投資於符合其副顧問確定的環境、社會和治理（「ESG」）標準的美國發行人的交易所交易股票證券。

info.description: T. Rowe Price Intermediate Municipal Income ETF seeks the highest level of income exempt from federal income taxes consistent with moderate price fluctuation. The fund normally invests at least 80% of its net assets, plus any borrowings for investment purposes, in investment-grade municipal securities or derivatives that are linked to or provides investment exposure to the municipal market. Under normal conditions, the fund's weighted average effective maturity will be four to twelve years. There are no maturity limitations on individual securities.
info.description_zh: T. Rowe Price 中等市政收入 ETF 尋求與溫和的價格波動相一致的最高水平的聯邦所得稅豁免收入。該基金通常將至少 80% 的淨資產以及任何用於投資目的的借款投資於與市政市場相關或提供投資風險的投資等級市政證券或衍生性商品。在正常情況下，該基金的加權平均有效期限為四至十二年。個別證券沒有期限限制。

info.description: Tenable Holdings, Inc. engages in the development of security software solutions. The firm offers Cyber Exposure which is a discipline for managing and measuring cybersecurity risk in the digital era. Its products include tenable.io, tenable.sc, tenable.ot, and nessus professional. The firm delivers solutions in the field of application security, cloud security, compliance, energy, finance, healthcare, and retail. It operates through the following geographical segments: The Americas, Europe, Middle East and Africa, and Asia Pacific. The company was founded by John C. Huffard, Jr. and Renaud M. Deraison in 2002 and is headquartered in Columbia, MD.
info.description_zh: Tenable Holdings, Inc. 從事安全軟體解決方案的開發。該公司提供 Cyber​​ Exposure，這是一門用於管理和衡量數位時代網路安全風險的學科。其產品包括 tenable.io、tenable.sc、tenable.ot 和 nessus professional。該公司提供應用安全、雲端安全、合規性、能源、金融、醫療保健和零售領域的解決方案。它透過以下地理區域開展業務：美洲、歐洲、中東和非洲以及亞太地區。該公司由 John C. Huffard, Jr. 和 Renaud M. Deraison 於 2002 年創立，總部位於馬裡蘭州哥倫比亞。

info.description: T.Rowe Price High Income Municipal ETF seeks to provide a high level of income exempt from federal income taxes. The fund normally invests at least 80% of its net assets (plus any borrowings for investment purposes) in municipal securities whose income is exempt from federal income taxes. Any derivatives that provide exposure to the investment focus suggested by the fund's name, or to one or more market risk factors associated with the investment focus suggested by the fund's name, are counted (as applicable) toward compliance with the fund's 80% investment policy.
info.description_zh: T.Rowe Price 高收入市政 ETF 旨在提供免徵聯邦所得稅的高收入。該基金通常將至少 80% 的淨資產（加上任何用於投資目的的借款）投資於市政證券，其收入免徵聯邦所得稅。任何提供基金名稱所建議的投資重點或與基金名稱所建議的投資重點相關的一個或多個市場風險因素的衍生品，均被計入（如適用）以符合基金的 80% 投資政策。

info.description: ProShares UltraPro QQQ seeks daily investment results, before fees and expenses, that correspond to three times (3x) the daily performance of the NASDAQ-100 Index. The fund invests in financial instruments that ProShare Advisors believes, in combination, should produce daily returns consistent with the fund's investment objective. The index includes 100 of the largest domestic and international non-financial companies listed on The Nasdaq Stock Market based on market capitalization. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: ProShares UltraPro QQQ 尋求每日投資結果（未計費用和開支），相當於 NASDAQ-100 指數每日表現的三倍 (3x)。該基金投資於 ProShare Advisors 認為綜合起來應產生與基金投資目標一致的每日回報的金融工具。該指數包括納斯達克股票市場上市的 100 家最大的國內和國際非金融公司（按市值計算）。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Interactive Strength, Inc. engages in the development and sale of an at-home fitness technology platform. It offers Forme, a digital fitness service that combines fitness hardware products with personal training and coaching services. It operates under the following geographical segments: the United States, the United Kingdom, and Taiwan. The company was founded by Trent A. Ward and Ben Bartlett on May 8, 2017 and is headquartered in Austin, TX.
info.description_zh: Interactive Strength, Inc. 從事家庭健身技術平台的開發與銷售。它提供 Forme，一種數位健身服務，將健身硬體產品與個人訓練和輔導服務結合。它在以下地理區域運作：美國、英國和台灣。該公司由 Trent A. Ward 和 Ben Bartlett 於 2017 年 5 月 8 日創立，總部位於德克薩斯州奧斯汀。

info.description: VictoryShares US Multi-Factor Minimum Volatility ETF seeks to provide investment results that track the performance of the Nasdaq Victory US Multi-Factor Minimum Volatility Index before fees and expenses. The fund seeks to achieve its investment objective by investing, under normal market conditions, at least 80% of its assets in securities included in the Nasdaq Victory US Multi-Factor Minimum Volatility Index (the "index"). The index utilizes a rules-based approach designed to generate investment returns with less volatility than the broader U.S. market.
info.description_zh: VictoryShares 美國多因子最低波動率 ETF 旨在提供追蹤納斯達克勝利美國多因素最低波動指數（未計費用和開支）表現的投資結果。該基金尋求透過在正常市場條件下將其至少 80% 的資產投資於納斯達克勝利美國多因素最低波動指數（「指數」）所包含的證券來實現其投資目標。該指數採用基於規則的方法，旨在產生比更廣泛的美國市場波動性更小的投資回報。

info.description: VirTra, Inc. is a provider of judgmental use of force training simulators, firearms training simulators and driving simulators for law enforcement, military, educational and commercial markets. Its simulators use software, hardware and content to create realistic training that does not require live ammunition or less-than-lethal munitions. It operates through the following segments: Simulators and Accessories, Extended Service-type Warranties, Customized Software and Custom Content, Installation and Training, Design and Prototyping, and Subscription Training Equipment Partnership. The company was founded by Robert D. Ferris in May 1993 and headquartered in Chandler, AZ.
info.description_zh: VirTra, Inc. 是一家為執法、軍事、教育和商業市場提供武力判斷使用訓練模擬器、槍械訓練模擬器和駕駛模擬器的提供者。其模擬器使用軟體、硬體和內容來創建不需要實彈或非致命彈藥的真實訓練。它透過以下部門運作：模擬器和配件、擴展服務型保固、客製化軟體和客製化內容、安裝和培訓、設計和原型製作以及訂閱培訓設備合作夥伴關係。該公司由 Robert D. Ferris 於 1993 年 5 月創立，總部位於亞利桑那州錢德勒。

info.description: Defiance Retail Kings ETF is an actively managed fund that targets long-term capital appreciation by investing in U.S.-listed companies demonstrating high retail investor sentiment and digital engagement. The fund utilizes a proprietary model to identify "Retail Kings"-companies that are favorites or trending leaders in online investor communities-while further vetting them for fundamental resilience and competitive moats.
info.description_zh: Defiance Retail Kings ETF 是一檔主動式管理基金，透過投資表現出高散戶投資者情緒和數位參與度的美國上市公司來實現長期資本增值。該基金利用專有模型來識別「零售之王」——線上投資者社群中最受歡迎或趨勢領先的公司——同時進一步審查它們的基本彈性和競爭護城河。

info.description: Photronics, Inc. engages in the provision of photomasks, which are quartz or glass plates containing microscopic images of electronic circuits for use in the fabrication of integrated circuits and flat-panel displays. The company was founded by Constantine S. Macricostas in 1969 and is headquartered in Brookfield, CT.
info.description_zh: Photronics, Inc. 從事提供光掩模業務，光掩模是包含電子電路顯微圖像的石英或玻璃板，用於製造積體電路和平板顯示器。該公司由 Constantine S. Macricostas 於 1969 年創立，總部位於康乃狄克州布魯克菲爾德。

info.description: First Trust Asia Pacific Ex-Japan AlphaDEX Fund seeks results that correspond generally to the price and yield (before the fund's fees and expenses) of an equity index called the NASDAQ AlphaDEX Asia Pacific Ex-Japan Index. The fund will normally invest at least 90% of its net assets (including investment borrowings) in the securities that comprise the index. The index is designed to select stocks from the NASDAQ Asia Pacific Ex-Japan Index that may generate positive alpha, or risk-adjusted returns, relative to traditional indices through the use of the AlphaDEX selection methodology.
info.description_zh: First Trust 亞太地區（日本除外）AlphaDEX 基金尋求與稱為納斯達克 AlphaDEX 亞太地區（日本除外）指數的股票指數的價格和收益率（在基金費用和開支之前）相對應的結果。該基金通常將至少 90% 的淨資產（包括投資借款）投資於構成該指數的證券。該指數旨在透過使用 AlphaDEX 選擇方法從納斯達克亞太（日本除外）指數中選擇相對於傳統指數可能產生正 alpha 或風險調整回報的股票。

info.description: Cognyte Software Ltd. engages in the development and provision of security analytics software. The firm offers its solutions to governments and enterprises. Its solutions include decision, network, operational, and threat intelligence analytics. The company was founded on May 21, 2020 and is headquartered in Herzliya Pituach, Israel.
info.description_zh: Cognyte Software Ltd. 從事安全分析軟體的開發和提供。該公司為政府和企業提供解決方案。其解決方案包括決策、網路、營運和威脅情報分析。該公司成立於2020年5月21日，總部位於以色列荷茲利亞皮圖阿赫。

info.description: Wynn Resorts Ltd. is a holding company, which engages in the design, development, and operation of destination casino resorts. It operates through the following segments: Wynn Palace, Wynn Macau, Las Vegas Operations, Encore Boston Harbor, and Corporate and Other. The company was founded by Stephen Alan Wynn, Elaine P. Wynn, and Kazuo Okada in 2002 and is headquartered in Las Vegas, NV.
info.description_zh: 永利度假村有限公司是一家控股公司，從事目的地賭場度假村的設計、開發和營運。該公司透過以下部門運作：永利皇宮部門、永利澳門部門、拉斯維加斯業務部門、安可波士頓港部門以及企業及其他部門。該公司由 Stephen Alan Wynn、Elaine P. Wynn 和 Kazuo Okada 於 2002 年創立，總部位於內華達州拉斯維加斯。

info.description: Future Vision II Acquisition Corp. is a blank check company, which engages in the purpose of effecting a merger, share exchange, asset acquisition, share purchase, reorganization or similar business combination with one or more businesses. The company was founded on January 30, 2024 and is headquartered in Shanghai, China.
info.description_zh: Future Vision II Acquisition Corp. 是一家空白支票公司，其目的是與一個或多個企業進行合併、股份交換、資產收購、股份購買、重組或類似業務合併。公司成立於2024年1月30日，總部位於中國上海。

info.description: Maplebear, Inc. engages in the design and development of an online application that offers grocery delivery and pick-up services. The firm offers Instacart which enables users to connect with personal shoppers in the area who pick up and deliver groceries from local stores. The company was founded by Apoorva Mehta, Brandon Leonardo, and Max Mullen in 2012 and is headquartered in San Francisco, CA.
info.description_zh: Maplebear, Inc. 從事設計和開發提供雜貨配送和提貨服務的線上應用程式。該公司提供 Instacart，使用戶能夠與該地區從當地商店提貨和送貨的個人購物者聯繫。該公司由 Apoorva Mehta、Brandon Leonardo 和 Max Mullen 於 2012 年創立，總部位於加州舊金山。

info.description: Smart Sand, Inc. engages in supplying frac sand and related services. The firm offers complete mine to wellsite proppant supply and logistics solutions. It operates through the following segments: Sand and SmartSystems. The Sand segment includes both frac sand sales and IPS sales. The SmartSystems segment focuses on the rental of patented SmartSystems equipment and related services provided to customers. The company was founded by Charles E. Young on July 19, 2011 and is headquartered in Yardley, PA.
info.industry_zh: 石油和天然氣設備與服務
info.description_zh: Smart Sand, Inc. 從事供應壓裂砂及相關服務。該公司提供完整的礦山到井場支撐劑供應和物流解決方案。它透過以下部門運作：Sand 部門和 SmartSystems 部門。砂子部門包括壓裂砂銷售和 IPS 銷售。 SmartSystems 部門專注於向客戶提供專利的 SmartSystems 設備的租賃和相關服務。該公司由 Charles E. Young 於 2011 年 7 月 19 日創立，總部位於賓夕法尼亞州亞德利。

info.description: Orchestra Biomed Holdings, Inc. engages in the provision of biomedical technologies to patients through risk-reward-sharing partnerships with medical device companies. The company was founded by David P. Hochman on May 25, 2020 and is headquartered in New Hope, PA.
info.description_zh: Orchestra Biomed Holdings, Inc. 透過與醫療器材公司建立風險回報共享合作夥伴關係，為病患提供生物醫學技術。該公司由 David P. Hochman 於 2020 年 5 月 25 日創立，總部位於賓夕法尼亞州紐霍普。

info.description: Rhinebeck Bancorp, Inc. operates as a bank holding company, which engages in the provision of banking services. It operates through the following segments: Commercial Real Estate, Residential Real Estate, Commercial and Industrial, and Consumer. The Commercial Estate segment is involved in construction, non-residential, and multi-family. The Residential Real Estate Segment focuses on borrower's residential real estate generally in a first lien position. The Commercial and Industrial segment includes loans made for purposes of financing the activities of commercial customers. The Consumer segment engages in indirect automobile loans, home equity loans, and other consumer loans. The company was founded on August 30, 2018 and is headquartered in Poughkeepsie, NY.
info.description_zh: Rhinebeck Bancorp, Inc. 作為一家銀行控股公司運營，提供銀行服務。它透過以下部門運作：商業房地產、住宅房地產、商業和工業以及消費者。商業地產部門涉及建築、非住宅和多戶住宅。住宅房地產部分主要關注借款人的住宅房地產，通常處於第一留置權位置。商業和工業部門包括為商業客戶活動融資而發放的貸款。消費者部門從事間接汽車貸款、房屋淨值貸款和其他消費貸款。該公司成立於2018年8月30日，總部位於紐約州波基普西。

info.description: Walmart, Inc. engages in the retail and wholesale business. The company offers an assortment of merchandise and services at everyday low prices. It operates through the following segments: Walmart U.S., Walmart International, and Sam's Club U.S. The Walmart U.S. segment operates as a mass merchandiser of consumer products, operating under the Walmart and Walmart Neighborhood Market brands, including walmart.com. The Walmart International segment includes operations of wholly-owned subsidiaries in Canada, Chile, China, and Africa, and majority-owned subsidiaries in India, as well as Mexico and Central America. The Sam's Club U.S. segment manages membership-only warehouse clubs and operates samsclub.com. The company was founded by Samuel Moore Walton and James Lawrence Walton on July 2, 1962 and is headquartered in Bentonville, AR.
info.description_zh: 沃爾瑪公司從事零售和批發業務。該公司以每日低價提供各種商品和服務。該公司透過以下部門運作：沃爾瑪美國部門、沃爾瑪國際部門和山姆會員店美國部門。沃爾瑪美國部門作為消費品的大型銷售商運營，以沃爾瑪和沃爾瑪鄰里市場品牌運營，包括walmart.com。沃爾瑪國際部門包括在加拿大、智利、中國和非洲的全資子公司以及在印度、墨西哥和中美洲的控股子公司。山姆會員店美國分會管理會員制倉儲俱樂部並經營 samsclub.com。該公司由塞繆爾·摩爾·沃爾頓 (Samuel Moore Walton) 和詹姆斯·勞倫斯·沃爾頓 (James Lawrence Walton) 於 1962 年 7 月 2 日創立，總部位於阿肯色州本頓維爾。

info.description: Leverage Shares 2X Long BBAI Daily ETF seeks daily levered investment results, before fees and expenses, of two times (200%) of the daily percentage change in the price of BBAI. The fund invests at least 80% of its net assets (plus borrowings for investment purposes) in financial instruments with economic characteristics that, in combination, provide 200% daily leveraged exposure to the price of BBAI, consistent with the fund's investment objective. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: 槓桿股票 2 倍多頭 BBAI 每日 ETF 尋求每日槓桿投資結果（未計費用和開支）為 BBAI 價格每日百分比變化的兩倍 (200%)。該基金將至少 80% 的淨資產（加上用於投資目的的借款）投資於具有經濟特徵的金融工具，這些金融工具組合起來可提供 BBAI 價格的 200% 每日槓桿敞口，這與基金的投資目標一致。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Hingham Institution for Savings provides community banking services. It is involved in the business of commercial and residential real estate mortgage lending, funded by retail deposits, wholesale deposits and borrowings. The company was founded in 1834 and is headquartered in Hingham, MA.
info.description_zh: 辛厄姆儲蓄機構提供社區銀行服務。它從事商業和住宅房地產抵押貸款業務，資金來源包括零售存款、批發存款和借款。該公司成立於 1834 年，總部位於馬薩諸塞州欣厄姆。

info.description: Whitehawk Therapeutics, Inc. operates as a clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company. It develops precision therapies for genetically-defined cancer patients with mTOR pathway driver alterations such as alterations in TSC1 or TSC2 genes. The company was founded by Neil Desai in November 2007 and is headquartered in Morristown, NJ.
info.description_zh: Whitehawk Therapeutics, Inc. 是一家臨床階段的生物製藥公司。它為具有 mTOR 路徑驅動改變（例如 TSC1 或 TSC2 基因改變）的基因定義癌症患者開發精準療法。該公司由 Neil Desai 於 2007 年 11 月創立，總部位於新澤西州莫里斯敦。

info.description: Albemarle Corp. engages in the development, manufacture, and marketing of chemicals for consumer electronics, petroleum refining, utilities, packaging, construction, transportation, pharmaceuticals, crop production, food-safety, and custom chemistry services. It operates through the following segments: Energy Storage, Specialties, and Ketjen. The Energy Storage segment develops and manufactures a broad range of basic lithium compounds, including lithium carbonate, lithium hydroxide, and lithium chloride. The Specialties segment focuses on optimizing a portfolio of bromine and specialized lithium solutions. The Ketjen segment consists of clean fuels technologies, fluidized catalytic cracking catalysts and additives, and performance catalyst solutions, which is primarily composed of organometallics and curatives. The company was founded in 1993 and is headquartered in Charlotte, NC.
info.description_zh: Albemarle Corp. 從事消費性電子、石油精煉、公用事業、包裝、建築、運輸、製藥、農作物生產、食品安全和客製化化學服務的化學品的開發、製造和行銷。它透過以下部門運作：能源儲存部門、專業部門和科琴部門。儲能部門開發和製造各種基本鋰化合物，包括碳酸鋰、氫氧化鋰和氯化鋰。特種產品部門專注於優化溴和特種鋰解決方案的產品組合。 Ketjen 部門包括清潔燃料技術、流化催化裂解催化劑和添加劑以及主要由有機金屬和固化劑組成的高性能催化劑解決方案。該公司成立於 1993 年，總部位於北卡羅來納州夏洛特。

info.description: Mobilicom Ltd. is an end-to-end provider of cyber security and smart solutions for drones, robotics and autonomous platforms. It designs, develops and delivers solutions targeting global drone, robotics and autonomous system manufacturers. The firm holds patented technology and know-how for Mobile Mesh networking. Its customers include corporates, governments and military departments. The company was founded by Oren Elkayam and Yossi Segal in 2006 and is headquartered in Shoham, Israel.
info.description_zh: Mobilicom Ltd. 是一家為無人機、機器人和自主平台提供網路安全和智慧解決方案的端到端供應商。它為全球無人機、機器人和自主系統製造商設計、開發和提供解決方案。該公司擁有行動網狀網路的專利技術和專有技術。其客戶包括企業、政府和軍事部門。該公司由 Oren Elkayam 和 Yossi Segal 於 2006 年創立，總部位於以色列 Shoham。

info.description: Roundhill Glp-1 & Weight Loss ETF seeks to provide capital appreciation. The fund's manager will invest at least 80% of its net assets (plus any borrowings for investment purposes) in the equity securities of GLP-1 & Weight Loss Companies or any derivative instruments (such as swap agreements or forward contracts) that utilize one or more GLP-1 & Weight Loss Companies as the reference asset. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: Roundhill Glp-1 和減肥 ETF 旨在提供資本增值。基金管理人將至少 80% 的淨資產（加上任何用於投資目的的借款）投資於 GLP-1 和減肥公司的股本證券或利用一家或多家 GLP-1 和減肥公司作為參考資產的任何衍生工具（例如掉期協議或遠期合約）。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: First Trust Emerging Markets Local Currency Bond ETF seeks maximum total return and current income. Under normal market conditions, the fund seeks to achieve its investment objective by investing at least 80% of its net assets (including investment borrowings) in bonds, notes and bills issued or guaranteed by entities incorporated or domiciled in emerging market countries (collectively, "Bonds") that are denominated in the local currency of the issuer. It is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: First Trust 新興市場本幣債券 ETF 尋求最大的總回報和當期收入。在正常市場條件下，該基金尋求透過將至少80%的淨資產（包括投資借款）投資於由在新興市場國家註冊或註冊的實體發行或擔保的以發行人當地貨幣計價的債券、票據和票據（統稱「債券」）來實現其投資目標。它是非多元化的。

info.description: Alpha Architect U.S. Quantitative Momentum ETF seeks long-term capital appreciation. The Adviser employs a multi-step, quantitative, rules-based methodology to identify a portfolio of approximately 50 to 100 equity securities with the highest relative momentum. A "momentum" style of investing emphasizes investing in securities that have had higher recent total return performance compared to other securities. The Adviser then employs proprietary screens to eliminate companies with issues that may negatively impact their momentum. The fund may also invest up to 20% of its assets in cash and cash equivalents, other investment companies, as well as securities and other instruments.
info.description_zh: Alpha Architect美國量化動量ETF尋求長期資本增值。該顧問採用多步驟、定量、基於規則的方法來確定由大約 50 至 100 種相對動量最高的股票證券組成的投資組合。 「動量」投資風格強調投資於近期總回報表現高於其他證券的證券。然後，顧問採用專有篩選來消除存在可能對其發展勢頭產生負面影響的問題的公司。該基金還可以將最多 20% 的資產投資於現金和現金等價物、其他投資公司以及證券和其他工具。

info.description: Super League Enterprise, Inc. creates innovative and immersive entertainment experiences, platform and audience monetization and dynamic content feeding channels across the world's top gaming platforms. Fueled by an insatiable desire to stay on the forefront of this ever-evolving meta landscape, Super League pioneer's proprietary digital solutions provide unparalleled access to the global gaming audience. It also creates vibrant in-game communities through the development of innovative experiences and custom content, delivering powerful opportunities for brands and advertisers to achieve impactful insights, and marketing outcomes with audiences of all ages. The company was founded by John C. Miller, David Steigelfest, and Brett Morris on October 1, 2014 and is headquartered in Santa Monica, CA.
info.description_zh: Super League Enterprise, Inc. 在全球頂級遊戲平台上創造創新和沈浸式娛樂體驗、平台和受眾貨幣化以及動態內容供給管道。在不斷發展的元景觀中保持領先地位的永不滿足的願望的推動下，超級聯賽先鋒的專有數位解決方案為全球遊戲觀眾提供了無與倫比的訪問機會。它還透過開發創新體驗和客製化內容來創建充滿活力的遊戲內社區，為品牌和廣告商提供強大的機會，以獲得有影響力的見解，並為所有年齡段的受眾帶來行銷成果。該公司由 John C. Miller、David Steigelfest 和 Brett Morris 於 2014 年 10 月 1 日創立，總部位於加州聖莫尼卡。

info.description: Carvana Co. is a holding company and an eCommerce platform, which engages in the buying and selling of used cars. The company was founded by Ernest Garcia, III, Benjamin Huston and Ryan Keeton in 2012 and is headquartered in Tempe, AZ.
info.description_zh: Carvana Co.是一家控股公司和電子商務平台，從事二手車買賣。該公司由 Ernest Garcia, III、Benjamin Huston 和 Ryan Keeton 於 2012 年創立，總部位於亞利桑那州坦佩。

info.description: First Trust Global Tactical Commodity Strategy Fund seeks to provide total return by providing investors with commodity exposure while seeking a relatively stable risk profile. The fund is an actively managed exchange-traded fund ("ETF") that seeks to achieve attractive risk adjusted returns by investing in commodity futures contracts, exchange-traded commodity linked instruments, and commodity linked total return swaps (collectively, "Commodities Instruments") through a wholly-owned subsidiary of the fund organized under the laws of the Cayman Islands (the "Subsidiary"). The advisor expects to gain exposure to these investments exclusively by investing in the Subsidiary.
info.description_zh: First Trust全球戰術商品策略基金旨在透過為投資者提供商品曝險來提供總回報，同時尋求相對穩定的風險狀況。該基金是一檔主動管理型交易所交易基金（「ETF」），旨在透過根據開曼群島法律組成的基金全資子公司（「子公司」）投資於商品期貨合約、交易所交易商品掛鉤工具和商品掛鉤總收益互換（統稱「商品工具」），從而獲得有吸引力的風險調整回報。顧問希望僅透過投資子公司來獲得這些投資的機會。

info.description: Tonix Pharmaceuticals Holding Corp. is a clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company, which focuses on the discovery, acquisition, and development of small molecules and biologics to treat and prevent human disease and alleviate suffering. Its portfolio includes TNX-102 SL, TNX-601, TNX-801, and TNX-1800. The company was founded by Seth Lederman and Donald W. Landry on November 16, 2007 and is headquartered in Berkeley Heights, NJ.
info.description_zh: Tonix Pharmaceuticals Holding Corp. 是一家臨床階段的生物製藥公司，專注於發現、收購和開發小分子和生物製劑，以治療和預防人類疾病並減輕痛苦。其產品組合包括 TNX-102 SL、TNX-601、TNX-801 和 TNX-1800。該公司由 Seth Lederman 和 Donald W. Landry 於 2007 年 11 月 16 日創立，總部位於新澤西州 Berkeley Heights。

info.description: Invesco Optimum Yield Diversified Commodity Strategy No K-1 ETF seeks long term capital appreciation. The fund is an actively managed exchange-traded fund ("ETF") that seeks to achieve its investment objective by investing in a combination of financial instruments that are economically linked to the world's most heavily traded commodities. Commodities are assets that have tangible properties, such as oil, agricultural produce or raw metals.
info.description_zh: 景順最佳收益多元化商品策略No K-1 ETF 尋求長期資本增值。該基金是一檔主動管理的交易所交易基金（「ETF」），旨在透過投資與全球交易最頻繁的商品經濟相關的金融工具組合來實現其投資目標。商品是具有有形財產的資產，例如石油、農產品或原料金屬。

info.description: Camtek Ltd. engages in the business of developing and manufacturing high-end inspection and metrology equipment for the semiconductor industry. The firm is also involved in inspecting integrated circuits and measuring its features on wafers throughout the production process of semiconductor devices, covering the front and mid-end and up to the beginning of assembly. The company was founded on October 21, 1987 and is headquartered in Migdal HaEmek, Israel.
info.description_zh: Camtek Ltd.從事半導體行業高端檢測和計量設備的開發和製造業務。該公司還參與在整個半導體裝置生產過程中檢查積體電路並測量其在晶圓上的特徵，涵蓋前端和中端直至組裝開始。該公司成立於1987年10月21日，總部位於以色列Migdal HaEmek。

info.description: Credo Technology Group Holding Ltd. engages in the development of connectivity solutions and products for the data infrastructure market. Its products include integrated circuits, active electrical cables, and SerDes chiplets. The company was founded by Chi Fung Cheng and Yat Tung Lam on 2008 and is headquartered in George Town, Cayman Islands.
info.description_zh: Credo Technology Group Holding Ltd. 致力於為資料基礎設施市場開發連接解決方案和產品。其產品包括積體電路、主動電纜和 SerDes 小晶片。該公司由 Chi Fung Cheng 和 Yat Tung Lam 於 2008 年創立，總部位於開曼群島喬治城。

info.description: Bionano Genomics, Inc. is a life sciences instrumentation company, which focuses on the genome analysis space.
