info.description: Capstone Holding Corp. is a growing platform of building products companies, focused on serving residential and commercial construction markets across the United States. Its current portfolio includes Instone, a national wholesale distributor of thin veneer stone and related masonry products. With over 30 years of operating history, Instone has established itself as the largest player in its category, offering a comprehensive range of manufactured and natural stone solutions. The company was founded on July 30, 1987 and is headquartered in Alsip, IL.
info.description_zh: Capstone Holding Corp. 是一家不斷發展的建築產品公司平台，專注於為美國各地的住宅和商業建築市場提供服務。其目前的產品組合包括 Instone，一家薄飾面石材及相關磚石產品的全國批發經銷商。 Instone 擁有 30 多年的經營歷史，已成為該類別中最大的參與者，提供全面的人造石和天然石材解決方案。該公司成立於 1987 年 7 月 30 日，總部位於伊利諾伊州阿爾西普。

info.description: MasterBeef Group is an investment holding company. It established multiple brands, namely Anping Grill, Chubby Bento, Chubby Noodles and Bao Pot, diversifying its operations into Taiwanese grill, Taiwanese bento and Taiwanese noodles. The company was founded by Oi Wai Chau, Oi Yee Chau, Tsz Kiu So, Ka Chun Lam and Shing Yan Lee in 2019 and is headquartered in Hong Kong.
info.description_zh: MasterBeef集團是一家投資控股公司。成立安平扒房、小胖便當、小胖麵、包鍋等多個品牌，業務多元化至台灣燒烤、台灣便當及台灣麵條。該公司由Oi Wai Chau、Oi Yee Chau、Tsz Kiu So、Ka Chun Lam和Shing Yan Lee於2019年創立，總部位於香港。

info.description: Steakholder Foods Ltd. is an international deep-tech food company, which engages in the provision of production technology and associated supplies needed to commercially produce structured alternative protein products. The firm is also involved in developing and selling two types of 3D-printing production machines and developing plant-based products that aim to replicate the complex textures of traditional meats such as beef steaks, white fish, shrimp, and eel. The company was founded by Arik Kaufman, Yaron Kaiser, Sharon Fima, and Omri Schanin on July 22, 1992 and is headquartered in Rehovot, Israel.
info.description_zh: Steakholder Foods Ltd.是一家國際高科技食品公司，致力於提供商業化生產結構化替代蛋白質產品所需的生產技術和相關供應品。該公司還參與開發和銷售兩種類型的 3D 列印生產機器，並開發植物性產品，旨在複製傳統肉類（如牛排、白魚、蝦和鰻魚）的複雜質地。該公司由 Arik Kaufman、Yaron Kaiser、Sharon Fima 和 Omri Schanin 於 1992 年 7 月 22 日創立，總部位於以色列雷霍沃特。

info.description: Socket Mobile, Inc. is a mobile data capture company, which engages in the provision of data capture and delivery solutions for enhanced productivity in workforce mobilization. Its products are incorporated into mobile applications used in point of sale (POS), commercial services (field workers), asset tracking, manufacturing process and quality control, transportation and logistics (goods tracking and movement), event management (ticketing, entry, access control, and identification), medical and education. The company's primary products are cordless data capture devices incorporating barcode scanning or RFID/Near Field Communications (NFC) technologies that connect over Bluetooth. All products work with applications running on smartphones, mobile computers and tablets using operating systems from Apple (iOS), Google (Android), and Microsoft (Windows). It also offers an easy-to-use software developer kit (Capture SDK) to application developers, which enables them to provide their users with advanced barcode scanning and RFID/NFC features. The firm's products are integrated in their application solutions and are marketed by the application developers or the resellers of their applications and number of registered developers for data capture applications continues to grow. The company was founded by Michael L. Gifford and Charlie Bass in March 1992 and is headquartered in Fremont, CA.
info.description_zh: Socket Mobile, Inc. 是一家行動數據採集公司，致力於提供數據採集和交付解決方案，以提高勞動力動員的生產力。其產品被納入銷售點 (POS)、商業服務（現場工作人員）、資產追蹤、製造過程和品質控制、運輸和物流（貨物追蹤和移動）、活動管理（票務、進入、存取控制和識別）、醫療和教育等領域使用的行動應用程式。該公司的主要產品是採用條碼掃描或透過藍牙連接的 RFID/近場通訊 (NFC) 技術的無線資料擷取設備。所有產品均可與使用 Apple (iOS)、Google (Android) 和 Microsoft (Windows) 作業系統的智慧型手機、行動電腦和平板電腦上執行的應用程式搭配使用。它還為應用程式開發人員提供易於使用的軟體開發工具包（Capture SDK），使他們能夠為用戶提供先進的條碼掃描和 RFID/NFC 功能。該公司的產品整合在他們的應用程式解決方案中，並由應用程式開發人員或其應用程式經銷商進行行銷，並且資料擷取應用程式的註冊開發人員數量持續增長。該公司由 Michael L. Gifford 和 Charlie Bass 於 1992 年 3 月創立，總部位於加州弗里蒙特。

info.description: W.F Holding Ltd. engages in the manufacture of fiberglass reinforced plastic and FRP products. It sells a range of FRP products, including filament wound and molded tanks, thermoplastic tanks, lining products, ducting and fitting products, air pollution control equipment, and custom-made products. The firm also offer delivery, installation and repair, maintenance services, and on-site consultation services. The company was founded on March 7, 2023 and is headquartered in Shah Alam, Malaysia.
info.description_zh: W.F Holding Ltd. 從事玻璃纖維增強塑膠和玻璃鋼製品的製造。該公司銷售一系列玻璃鋼產品，包括纖維纏繞和模壓儲罐、熱塑性儲罐、襯裡產品、管道和配件產品、空氣污染控制設備和客製化產品。該公司還提供送貨、安裝和維修、維護服務以及現場諮詢服務。該公司成立於2023年3月7日，總部位於馬來西亞莎阿南。

info.description: ClearOne, Inc. engages in the design, development, and marketing of professional audio conferencing, microphone, and video collaboration solutions. The company was founded in 1983 and is headquartered in Salt Lake City, UT.
info.description_zh: ClearOne, Inc. 從事專業音訊會議、麥克風和視訊協作解決方案的設計、開發和行銷。該公司成立於 1983 年，總部位於猶他州鹽湖城。

info.description: Yunji, Inc. is a holding company, which engages in the provision of social e-commerce platforms. It offers Yunji App, a combination of Yunji VIP App and Yunji Flagship App. It also provides solutions and services that allow suppliers to benefit from the firm's scale of operations and marketing capabilities. The company was founded by Shang Lue Xiao in May 2015 and is headquartered in Hangzhou, China.
info.description_zh: 雲集有限公司是一家控股公司，從事提供社交電子商務平台業務。它提供雲集App，雲集VIP應用程式和雲集旗艦應用程式的組合。它還提供解決方案和服務，使供應商能夠從公司的營運規模和行銷能力中受益。該公司由尚略肖於2015年5月創立，總部位於中國杭州。

info.description: Wing Yip Food Holdings Group Ltd. is a holding company. It engages in the business of processing, selling, and distributing cured meat products including cured pork sausages, cured pork meat, and other cured meat products such as cured chicken, cured duck, and cured fish; snack products including ready-to-eat sausages, jerky, duck necks, duck feet, and clay pot rice; and frozen meat products including frozen sausages, frozen beef patties, and frozen chicken breast fillets. The company was founded on April 24, 2015 and is headquartered in Zhongshan, China.
info.description_zh: 永業食品控股集團有限公司是一家控股公司。從事醃製肉製品的加工、銷售和分銷業務，包括醃製豬肉香腸、醃製豬肉以及醃製雞、醃鴨、醃魚等其他醃製肉製品；即食香腸、肉乾、鴨脖、鴨腳、煲仔飯等休閒食品；以及冷凍肉類製品，包括冷凍香腸、冷凍牛肉餅和冷凍雞胸肉片。公司成立於2015年4月24日，總部位於中國中山。

info.description: Zai Lab Ltd. is a biopharmaceutical company, which engages in the developing and commercializing therapies that address medical conditions with unmet needs in oncology, autoimmune disorders, infectious diseases, and neuroscience. Its products include Zejula, Optune, Qinlock, and Nuzyra. The company was founded by Samantha Ying Du and Marietta Wu in April 2014 and is headquartered in Shanghai, China.
info.description_zh: 再鼎醫藥 (Zai Lab Ltd.) 是一家生物製藥公司，致力於開發和商業化療法，解決腫瘤學、自體免疫疾病、傳染病和神經科學領域未滿足需求的醫療狀況。其產品包括 Zejula、Optune、Qinlock 和 Nuzyra。該公司由杜英和吳瑪麗於2014年4月創立，總部位於中國上海。

info.description: Ceribell, Inc. is a commercial-stage medical technology company, which engages in the provision of transforming the diagnosis and management of patients with serious neurological conditions. Its products include Point-of-Care EEG, which enables early detection and management of suspected seizure patients, promoting precise patient care and hospital-wide efficiencies, Clarity, an AI algorithm that interprets EEG in real-time, providing bedside alerts and continuous monitoring for status epilepticus, and EEG Portal, which makes it easy to remotely review EEG in real-time with pre-annotated EEG insights. The company was founded by Xing Juan Chao, Josef Parvizi, and Chris Chafe on August 29, 2014 and is headquartered in Sunnyvale, CA.
info.description_zh: Ceribell, Inc. 是一家商業階段的醫療技術公司，致力於改變嚴重神經系統疾病患者的診斷和管理。其產品包括床邊腦電圖（Point-of-Care EEG），它能夠早期發現和管理疑似癲癇患者，促進精確的患者護理和全院效率；Clarity，一種實時解釋腦電圖的人工智能演算法，提供床邊警報和持續監測癲癇持續狀態；以及腦電圖門戶（EEG Portal），它可以通過預先註釋的腦電圖。該公司由 Xing Juan Chao、Josef Parvizi 和 Chris Chafe 於 2014 年 8 月 29 日創立，總部位於加州桑尼維爾。

info.description: Harte-Hanks, Inc. is a global customer experience company operating in three business segments: Marketing Services, Customer Care, and Fulfillment & Logistics Services. The company's mission is to partner with clients to provide them with a robust customer-experience, or CX, strategy, data-driven analytics and actionable insights combined with seamless program execution to better understand, attract, and engage their customers. Its services include strategic planning, data strategy, performance analytics, creative development, and execution, technology enablement, marketing automation, B2B and B2C e-commerce, cross-channel customer care, and product, print, and mail fulfillment. The company was founded in 1923 and is headquartered in Chelmsford, MA.
info.description_zh: Harte-Hanks, Inc. 是一家全球客戶體驗公司，經營三個業務部門：行銷服務、客戶服務以及履行和物流服務。該公司的使命是與客戶合作，為他們提供強大的客戶體驗（CX）、策略、數據驅動的分析和可行的見解，並結合無縫的專案執行，以更好地了解、吸引和吸引客戶。其服務包括策略規劃、數據策略、績效分析、創意開發和執行、技術支援、行銷自動化、B2B 和 B2C 電子商務、跨通路客戶服務以及產品、印刷和郵件履行。該公司成立於 1923 年，總部位於馬薩諸塞州切姆斯福德。

info.description: FTAI Infrastructure, Inc. provides infrastructure and equipment for transportation. It operates through the following segments: Railroad, Jefferson Terminal, Repauno, Power and Gas, Sustainability and Energy Transition, and Corporate and Other. It is in the business of acquiring, developing and operating assets and businesses that represent critical infrastructure for customers in the transportation and energy industries. The company was founded on December 13, 2021 and is headquartered in New York, NY.
info.description_zh: FTAI Infrastructure, Inc. 提供交通基礎設施和設備。該公司透過以下部門運營：鐵路部門、傑斐遜車站部門、雷帕諾部門、電力和天然氣部門、永續發展和能源轉型部門以及企業和其他部門。它的業務是收購、開發和營運代表運輸和能源行業客戶關鍵基礎設施的資產和業務。該公司成立於2021年12月13日，總部位於紐約州紐約。

info.description: AXS 2X Innovation ETF seeks daily investment results, before fees and expenses, of 200% of the daily performance of the ARK Innovation ETF. The fund will enter into one or more swap agreements with major global financial institutions for a specified period ranging from a day to more than one year whereby the fund and the global financial institution will agree to exchange the return (or differentials in rates of return) earned or realized on the ARK Innovation ETF. It is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: AXS 2X Innovation ETF 尋求每日投資結果（未計費用和開支）為 ARK Innovation ETF 每日業績的 200%。該基金將與全球主要金融機構簽訂一份或多份互換協議，期限從一天到一年以上不等，根據該協議，基金和全球金融機構將同意交換在ARK Innovation ETF上賺取或實現的回報（或回報率差異）。它是非多元化的。

info.description: Marathon Petroleum Corp. engages in the refining, marketing, and transportation of petroleum products. It operates through the Refining and Marketing, and Midstream segments. The Refining and Marketing segment includes refining crude oil and other feedstocks, purchasing ethanol, and refined products for resale and distribution of refined products. The Midstream segment refers to transportation, storing, distribution, and marketing of crude oil and refined products. The company was founded in 1887 and is headquartered in Findlay, OH.
info.industry_zh: 石油與天然氣精煉與行銷
info.description_zh: 馬拉松石油公司從事石油產品的精煉、行銷和運輸。它透過煉油和行銷以及中游部門運作。煉油和行銷部門包括煉油原油和其他原料、採購乙醇以及用於轉售和分銷煉油產品的煉油產品。中游部門是指原油和成品油的運輸、儲存、分銷和行銷。該公司成立於 1887 年，總部位於俄亥俄州芬德利。

info.description: Elevra Lithium Ltd. engages in the exploration, development, and mining of lithium raw materials. Its portfolio includes projects in Quebec, Canada, United States, Ghana and Western Australia. The company was founded in 2000 and is headquartered in Brisbane, Australia.
info.description_zh: Elevra Lithium Ltd.從事鋰原料的勘探、開發和開採。其投資組合包括魁北克、加拿大、美國、加納和西澳大利亞的項目。該公司成立於2000年，總部位於澳洲布里斯班。

info.description: Kestra Medical Technologies Ltd. is a commercial-stage, wearable medical device and digital healthcare company. It focused on transforming patient outcomes in cardiovascular disease using monitoring and therapeutic intervention technologies that are intuitive, intelligent, and connected. The company was founded by Brian Webster and Traci S. Umberger in 2014 and is headquartered in Kirkland, WA.
info.description_zh: Kestra Medical Technologies Ltd. 是一家商業階段的可穿戴醫療設備和數位醫療保健公司。它專注於利用直觀、智慧和互聯的監測和治療幹預技術來改變心血管疾病患者的治療結果。該公司由 Brian Webster 和 Traci S. Umberger 於 2014 年創立，總部位於華盛頓州柯克蘭。

info.description: Carlyle Secured Lending, Inc. is a global investment firm with deep industry expertise that deploys private capital. The company was founded in February 2012, and is headquartered in New York, NY.
info.description_zh: 凱雷擔保貸款公司 (Carlyle Secured Lending, Inc.) 是一家全球投資公司，擁有深厚的行業專業知識，可部署私人資本。該公司成立於2012年2月，總部位於紐約州紐約市。

info.description: Invesco DWA Energy Momentum ETF seeks to track the investment results (before fees and expenses) of the Dorsey Wright Energy Technical Leaders Index (the "underlying index"). The fund generally will invest at least 90% of its total assets in the securities that comprise the underlying index. The underlying index is composed of at least 30 securities of companies in the energy sector that have powerful relative strength or "momentum" characteristics.
info.description_zh: Invesco DWA Energy Momentum ETF 旨在追蹤 Dorsey Wright Energy Technical Leaders Index（「基礎指數」）的投資結果（扣除費用和開支之前）。該基金通常將至少 90% 的總資產投資於構成標的指數的證券。基礎指數由至少 30 家能源產業公司的證券組成，這些公司具有強大的相對實力或「動量」特徵。

info.description: Omada Health, Inc. engages in the provision of digital health services. It offers online diabetes and obesity prevention programs, health coaching, and integration of web, mobile, and smart devices. The company was founded by Andrew DiMichele, Adrian James, and Sean Duffy in 2011 and is headquartered in South San Francisco, CA.
info.description_zh: Omada Health, Inc. 從事提供數位醫療服務。它提供線上糖尿病和肥胖預防計劃、健康指導以及網路、行動和智慧型裝置的整合。該公司由 Andrew DiMichele、Adrian James 和 Sean Duffy 於 2011 年創立，總部位於加州南舊金山。

info.description: Keysight Technologies, Inc. engages in the provision of electronic design and test solutions that are used in the design, development, manufacture, installation, deployment, validation, optimization, and secure operation of electronics systems to communications, networking, and electronics industries. It operates through the Communications Solutions Group (CSG) and Electronic Industrial Solutions Group (EISG) segments. The CSG segment serves customers spanning the global commercial communications and aerospace, defense, and government end markets. The EISG segment offers test and measurement solutions across electronic industrial end markets, focusing on applications in the automotive, and energy industry and measurement solutions for semiconductor design and manufacturing, consumer electronics, education, and general electronics manufacturing. The company was founded by William R. Hewlett and David Packard in 1937 and is headquartered in Santa Rosa, CA.
info.description_zh: 是德科技公司致力於提供電子設計和測試解決方案，這些解決方案用於通訊、網路和電子行業電子系統的設計、開發、製造、安裝、部署、驗證、最佳化和安全操作。它透過通訊解決方案集團（CSG）和電子工業解決方案集團（EISG）部門運作。 CSG 部門為全球商業通訊、航空航太、國防和政府終端市場的客戶提供服務。 EISG 部門提供跨電子工業終端市場的測試和測量解決方案，重點關注汽車和能源產業的應用以及半導體設計和製造、消費性電子、教育和通用電子製造的測量解決方案。該公司由 William R. Hewlett 和 David Packard 於 1937 年創立，總部位於加州聖羅莎。

info.description: JPMorgan U.S. Tech Leaders ETF seeks to provide long-term capital appreciation. The fund will invest primarily in equity securities issued by technology and technology-enabled companies which the adviser believes are leaders and where the magnitude and/or duration of future growth for these companies is underappreciated by the market.
info.description_zh: 摩根大通美國科技領袖 ETF 尋求提供長期資本增值。該基金將主要投資於顧問認為處於領先地位的技術和技術支援公司發行的股本證券，並且這些公司未來成長的規模和/或持續時間被市場低估。

info.description: Beta Bionics, Inc. is a commercial-stage medical device company. It engages in the design, development, and commercialization of solutions for insulin-requiring people with diabetes. The company was founded by Edward R. Damiano on October 21, 2015 and is headquartered in Irvine, CA.
info.description_zh: Beta Bionics, Inc. 是一家商業階段的醫療器材公司。它致力於為需要胰島素的糖尿病患者設計、開發和商業化解決方案。該公司由 Edward R. Damiano 於 2015 年 10 月 21 日創立，總部位於加州歐文。

info.description: Nicola Mining, Inc. engages in the business of identification, acquisition, and exploration of mineral property in Canda. Its projects include New Craigmont Copper, Dominion Creek and Treasure Mountain Silver. The company was founded in March 1980 and is headquartered in Lower Nicola, Canada.
info.description_zh: Nicola Mining, Inc. 在加拿大從事礦產鑑定、收購和勘探業務。其項目包括New Craigmont Copper、Dominion Creek 和Treasure Mountain Silver。該公司成立於1980年3月，總部位於加拿大下尼古拉。

info.description: Ciena Corp. is a network technology company, which engages in the provision of hardware, software, and services to network operators, as well as enabling enhanced network capacity, service delivery, and automation. It operates through the following segments: Networking Platforms, Platform Software and Services, Blue Planet Automation Software and Services, and Global Services. The Networking Platforms segment consists of converged packet optical and packet networking portfolios. The Platform Software and Services segment provides analytics, data, and planning tools to assist customers in managing its networking platforms products. The Blue Planet Automation Software and Services segment enables customers to implement large-scale software and IT-led OSS transformations by transforming legacy networks into service ready networks. The Global Services segment offers a broad suite of value-added services. The company was founded by Patrick H. Nettles and Kevin Brian Kimberlin in 1992 and is headquartered in Hanover, MD.
info.description_zh: Ciena Corp. 是一家網路技術公司，致力於向網路營運商提供硬體、軟體和服務，並增強網路容量、服務交付和自動化。它透過以下部門運作：網路平台、平台軟體和服務、藍色星球自動化軟體和服務以及全球服務。網路平台部分由融合分組光纖和分組網路產品組合組成。平台軟體和服務部門提供分析、數據和規劃工具，以協助客戶管理其網路平台產品。 Blue Planet自動化軟體和服務部門使客戶能夠透過將傳統網路轉變為服務就緒網路來實施大規模軟體和IT主導的OSS轉型。全球服務部門提供廣泛的增值服務。該公司由 Patrick H. Nettles 和 Kevin Brian Kimberlin 於 1992 年創立，總部位於馬裡蘭州漢諾威。

info.description: Pacer Cash COWZ 100-Nasdaq 100 Rotator ETF seeks to track the total return performance, before fees and expenses, of the Cash COWZ 100-Nasdaq 100 Rotator Index. The index uses an objective, rules-based methodology to provide exposure to large-capitalization companies. Under normal circumstances, at least 80% of the fund's net assets (plus any borrowings for investment purposes) will be invested in equity securities that are the component securities of the index. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: Pacer Cash COWZ 100-Nasdaq 100 Rotator ETF 旨在追蹤 Cash COWZ 100-Nasdaq 100 Rotator Index 的總回報表現（扣除費用和開支）。該指數採用客觀、基於規則的方法來提供對大市值公司的投資。在正常情況下，至少 80% 的基金淨資產（加上任何用於投資目的的借款）將投資於作為指數組成證券的股本證券。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Pegasystems, Inc. engages in the development, market, license, and support of software, which allows organizations to build, deploy, and change enterprise applications. Its product, Pega Infinity, helps connect enterprises to their customers in real-time across channels, streamline business operations, and adapt to meet changing requirements. The company was founded by Alan Trefler in 1983 and is headquartered in Waltham, MA.
info.description_zh: Pegasystems, Inc. 從事軟體的開發、行銷、授權和支持，使組織能夠建置、部署和更改企業應用程式。其產品 Pega Infinity 可協助企業跨通路即時連接客戶、簡化業務營運並適應不斷變化的需求。該公司由 Alan Trefler 於 1983 年創立，總部位於馬薩諸塞州沃爾瑟姆。

info.description: ERShares Entrepreneur ETF seeks long-term capital appreciation. The fund invests primarily in equity securities of mid and large capitalization companies traded on the NASDAQ, the New York Stock Exchange or other major U.S. exchanges. Equity securities include common stocks, preferred stocks, convertible preferred stocks, American Depositary Receipts (ADRs) (sponsored only) and Global Depositary Receipts (GDRs) (sponsored only). The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: ERShares Entrepreneur ETF 尋求長期資本增值。該基金主要投資於在納斯達克、紐約證券交易所或美國其他主要交易所交易的大中型公司的股票證券。股本證券包括普通股、優先股、可轉換優先股、美國存託憑證（ADR）（僅限保薦）及全球存託憑證（GDR）（僅限保薦）。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Blaize Holdings, Inc. provides artificial intelligence solutions. It develops hardware computing platforms for augmented reality, drones, and automobiles. The company was founded by Dinakar C. Munagala, Satyaki Koneru, and Ke Yin in January 2010 and is headquartered in El Dorado Hills, CA.
info.description_zh: Blaize Holdings, Inc. 提供人工智慧解決方案。它為擴增實境、無人機和汽車開發硬體運算平台。該公司由 Dinakar C. Munagala、Satyaki Koneru 和 Ke Yin 於 2010 年 1 月創立，總部位於加州埃爾多拉多山。

info.description: First Trust International Equity Opportunities ETF seeks investment results that correspond generally to the price and yield (before the fund's fees and expenses) of an index called the IPOX  International Index. The fund will normally invest at least 90% of its net assets (including investment borrowings) in the common stocks and depositary receipts that comprise the index. The index is a market-cap weighted portfolio measuring the performance of the top 50 companies domiciled outside the United States ranked quarterly by market capitalization in the IPOX  Global Composite Index and represents, on average, 25% of the total market capitalization of the base index. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: First Trust International Equity Opportunities ETF 尋求的投資結果通常與名為 IPOX International Index 的指數的價格和收益率（在基金費用和開支之前）相對應。該基金通常將至少 90% 的淨資產（包括投資借款）投資於構成該指數的普通股和存託憑證。該指數是一個市值加權投資組合，衡量美國境外註冊的前 50 名公司的業績，按季度在 IPOX 全球綜合指數中的市值排名，平均佔基礎指數總市值的 25%。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: PurePlay Nvidia Ecosystem Picks & Shovels Index ETF seeks to track the performance of a rules-based index designed to provide targeted, passive exposure to global public companies representing the full upstream and downstream value chain enabling Nvidia Corporation to manufacture, assemble, deploy, and operate high-performance computer systems. The fund employs a thematic supply-chain selection methodology using FactSet relationship data and a 50% revenue contribution threshold across six designated functional pillars to capture the physical infrastructure behind artificial intelligence deployment, while explicitly avoiding direct equity investments in shares of Nvidia Corporation.
info.description_zh: PurePlay Nvidia Ecosystem Picks & Shovels Index ETF 旨在追蹤基於規則的指數的表現，該指數旨在為代表整個上游和下游價值鏈的全球上市公司提供有針對性的被動投資，使 Nvidia Corporation 能夠製造、組裝、部署和運營高性能電腦系統。該基金採用主題供應鏈選擇方法，利用 FactSet 關係數據和跨六個指定功能支柱的 50% 收入貢獻門檻來捕獲人工智慧部署背後的實體基礎設施，同時明確避免對 Nvidia 公司股票的直接股權投資。

info.description: Invesco S&P SmallCap Energy ETF seeks to track the investment results (before fees and expenses) of the S&P SmallCap 600 Capped Energy Index (the "underlying index"). The fund generally will invest at least 90% of its total assets in the securities that comprise the underlying index. Strictly in accordance with its guidelines and mandated procedures, S&P Dow Jones Indices, LLC (the "index provider") compiles, maintains and calculates the underlying index, which is designed to measure the performance of securities of small-capitalization U.S. companies in the energy sector, as defined by the Global Industry Classification Standard ("GICS  "). It is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: Invesco S&P SmallCap Energy ETF 旨在追蹤 S&P SmallCap 600 Capped Energy Index（「基礎指數」）的投資結果（扣除費用和開支）。該基金通常將至少 90% 的總資產投資於構成標的指數的證券。 S&P Dow Jones Indices, LLC（「指數提供者」）嚴格按照其指導方針和規定程序編制、維護和計算基礎指數，該指數旨在衡量全球行業分類標準（「GICS」）所定義的美國小型公司在能源領域的證券表現。它是非多元化的。

info.description: T. Rowe Price Technology ETF seeks to provide long-term capital growth. The fund normally invests at least 80% of its net assets (plus borrowings for investments purposes) in securities of companies that the Advisor expects to generate a majority of their revenue from technology or enablement through technology. The fund's managers consider technology enabled companies as those whose competitive edge and/or market share are largely based on their technology capabilities. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: T. Rowe Price Technology ETF 尋求提供長期資本成長。該基金通常將至少 80% 的淨資產（加上用於投資目的的借款）投資於顧問預計大部分收入來自技術或透過技術實現的公司的證券。該基金的經理人認為，技術驅動型公司的競爭優勢和/或市佔率很大程度上取決於其技術能力。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Calamos Dynamic Convertible and Income Fund is a closed ended fixed income mutual fund launched by Calamos Investments LLC. It is managed by Calamos Advisors LLC. The fund invests in the fixed income markets of the United States. It primarily invests in a portfolio of convertible securities, investment grade and below investment grade bonds, loans, equity-linked notes, and floating rate securities. The fund also invests through derivatives such as options. It employs fundamental analysis with a top-down global macroeconomic approach to create its portfolio. Calamos Dynamic Convertible and Income Fund was formed on March 11, 2014 and is domiciled in the United States.
info.description_zh: Calamos Dynamic Convertible and Income Fund 是 Calamos Investments LLC 推出的封閉式固定收益共同基金。它由 Calamos Advisors LLC 管理。該基金投資於美國的固定收益市場。它主要投資於可轉換證券、投資等級及低於投資等級債券、貸款、股票掛鉤票據和浮動利率證券的投資組合。該基金也透過選擇權等衍生性商品進行投資。它採用基本面分析和自上而下的全球宏觀經濟方法來創建其投資組合。 Calamos Dynamic Convertible and Income Fund 成立於 2014 年 3 月 11 日，註冊地為美國。

info.description: First Trust Developed Markets Ex-US AlphaDEX Fund seeks results that correspond generally to the price and yield (before the fund's fees and expenses) of an equity index called the NASDAQ AlphaDEX Developed Markets Ex-US Index. The fund will normally invest at least 90% of its net assets (including investment borrowings) in the securities that comprise the index. The index is designed to select stocks from the NASDAQ Developed Markets Ex-US Index that may generate positive alpha, or risk-adjusted returns, relative to traditional indices through the use of the AlphaDEX selection methodology.
info.description_zh: First Trust 已開發市場（美國除外）AlphaDEX 基金尋求與稱為納斯達克 AlphaDEX 已開發市場（美國除外）指數的股票指數的價格和收益率（在基金費用和開支之前）相對應的結果。該基金通常將至少 90% 的淨資產（包括投資借款）投資於構成該指數的證券。該指數旨在透過使用 AlphaDEX 選擇方法從納斯達克發達市場（美國除外）中選擇相對於傳統指數可產生正 alpha 或風險調整回報的股票。

info.description: iShares ESG Advanced MSCI USA ETF seeks to track the investment results of the MSCI USA Choice ESG Screened Index (the "underlying index"). The underlying index is a free float-adjusted market capitalization-weighted index designed to reflect the equity performance of large- and mid-capitalization U.S. companies with favorable environmental, social and governance ("ESG") ratings while applying extensive screens, including removing fossil fuel exposure. The fund generally will invest at least 90% of its assets in the component securities of the underlying index. It is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: iShares ESG Advanced MSCI USA ETF 旨在追蹤 MSCI USA Choice ESG 篩選指數（「基礎指數」）的投資結果。基礎指數是自由流通量調整後的市值加權指數，旨在反映具有良好環境、社會和治理（“ESG”）評級的大中型美國公司的股票表現，同時應用廣泛的篩選，包括消除化石燃料風險。該基金通常將至少 90% 的資產投資於相關指數的成分證券。它是非多元化的。

info.description: Launchpad Cadenza Acquisition Corp. I is a blank check company, which engages in the purpose of effecting a merger, amalgamation, share exchange, asset acquisition, share purchase, reorganization or other similar business combination, involving one or more businesses or assets. The company was founded on June 27, 2025 and is headquartered in Oakland, CA.
info.description_zh: Launchpad Cadenza Acquisition Corp. I 是一家空白支票公司，其目的是實現涉及一項或多項業務或資產的合併、合併、股份交換、資產收購、股份購買、重組或其他類似業務合併。該公司成立於2025年6月27日，總部位於加州奧克蘭。

info.description: Invesco NASDAQ Future Gen 200 ETF seeks to track the investment results (before fees and expenses) of the Nasdaq Innovators Completion Cap IndexTM. The fund generally will invest at least 90% of its total assets in the securities that comprise the index. The index excludes securities of issuers included in the Nasdaq-100 Index (an index that measures the performance of 100 of the largest Nasdaq-listed non-financial companies by market capitalization) and the Nasdaq Next Generation 100 Index (an index that measures the performance of the 100 largest Nasdaq-listed companies outside of the NASDAQ-100 Index based on market capitalization). The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: Invesco NASDAQ Future Gen 200 ETF 旨在追蹤納斯達克創新者完成上限指數 (Nasdaq Innovators Completion Cap IndexTM) 的投資結果（未計費用和開支）。該基金通常會將至少 90% 的總資產投資於構成該指數的證券。該指數不包括納斯達克 100 指數（按市值衡量納斯達克上市的 100 家最大非金融公司業績的指數）和納斯達克下一代 100 指數（根據市值衡量納斯達克 100 指數以外的 100 家最大的納斯達克上市公司的業績的指數）所包含的發行人的證券。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: First Trust Nasdaq Oil & Gas ETF seeks investment results that correspond generally to the price and yield (before the fund's fees and expenses) of the Nasdaq US Smart Oil & Gas IndexTM. The fund will normally invest at least 90% of its net assets (including investment borrowings) in the common stocks and depository receipts that comprise the index. The index is designed to provide exposure to U.S. companies comprising the oil and gas sector that have been selected based upon their liquidity and weighted based upon their cumulative score on three investing factors: volatility, value and growth. It is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: First Trust 納斯達克石油和天然氣 ETF 尋求與納斯達克美國智慧石油和天然氣指數TM 的價格和收益率（未計基金費用和開支）相對應的投資結果。該基金通常將至少 90% 的淨資產（包括投資借款）投資於構成該指數的普通股和存託憑證。該指數旨在提供對包括石油和天然氣行業在內的美國公司的投資，這些公司是根據其流動性進行選擇的，並根據其在三個投資因素（波動性、價值和增長）的累積得分進行加權。它是非多元化的。

info.description: iShares MSCI Emerging Markets ex China ETF seeks to track the investment results of the MSCI Emerging Markets ex China Index (the "underlying index"). The fund generally will invest at least 80% of its assets in the component securities of the index and in investments that have economic characteristics that are substantially identical to the component securities of its index and may invest up to 20% of its assets in certain futures, options and swap contracts, cash and cash equivalents. The index is a free float-adjusted market capitalization-weighted index that captures large- and mid-capitalization stocks across 23 of the 24 Emerging Markets countries, excluding China.
info.description_zh: iShares MSCI 新兴市场（中国除外）ETF 旨在追踪 MSCI 新兴市场（中国除外）指数（“基础指数”）的投资结果。該基金通常將至少 80% 的資產投資於該指數的組成證券以及具有與其指數組成證券基本相同的經濟特徵的投資，並可能將最多 20% 的資產投資於某些期貨、選擇權和掉期合約、現金和現金等價物。該指數是一個自由流通量調整後的市值加權指數，涵蓋 24 個新興市場國家中 23 個國家（不包括中國）的大中型股票。

info.description: Russell Inv Emerging Markets Equity Active ETF seeks to provide long term capital growth. The fund has a non-fundamental policy to invest, under normal circumstances, at least 80% of the value of its net assets plus borrowings for investment purposes in equity securities economically tied to emerging markets countries. The fund principally invests in equity securities, including common stock and preferred stock, of emerging markets companies, and in depositary receipts representing shares in such companies.
info.description_zh: Russell Inv Emerging Markets Equity Active ETF 致力於提供長期資本成長。該基金的非基本政策是，在正常情況下，將其淨資產價值的至少80%加上用於投資目的的借款投資於與新興市場國家經濟相關的股本證券。該基金主要投資於新興市場公司的股本證券，包括普通股和優先股，以及代表此類公司股份的存託憑證。

info.description: Sophus Capital Emerging Market Small Cap ETF is an actively managed fund that seeks long-term capital appreciation by investing at least 80% of its net assets in equity securities-including common and preferred stock, depositary receipts (ADRs, GDRs, EDRs), and ETFs-issued by small-capitalization companies located in or tied economically to emerging and frontier markets. The strategy combines quantitative screening via a proprietary alpha model ranking approximately 4,500 small-cap stocks with bottom-up fundamental analysis to build a diversified portfolio targeting companies positioned for sustainable earnings growth and positive earnings revisions at attractive valuations.
info.description_zh: Sophus Capital Emerging Market Small Cap ETF 是一檔主動管理基金，透過將至少 80% 的淨資產投資於由位於新興和前沿市場或與新興和前沿市場經濟相關的小型資本公司發行的股本證券（包括普通股和優先股、存託憑證（ADR、GDR、EDR）和 ETF）來尋求長期資本增值。該策略將透過專有的阿爾法模型對約 4,500 隻小型股進行排名的定量篩選與自下而上的基本面分析結合起來，建立一個多元化的投資組合，目標是那些定位於可持續盈利增長和以有吸引力的估值進行積極盈利修正的公司。

info.description: Defiance Daily Target 2X Long DKNG ETF seeks stment results, before fees and expenses, of two times (200%) the daily percentage change in the share price of DraftKings Inc. (Nasdaq: DKNG). The fund is an actively managed exchange traded fund ("ETF") that attempts to achieve two times (200%) the daily percentage change in the share price of the underlying security by employing derivatives, namely swap agreements and/or listed options contracts. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: Defiance Daily Target 2X Long DKNG ETF 尋求在費用和開支之前，DraftKings Inc.（納斯達克股票代碼：DKNG）股價每日百分比變化兩倍（200%）的評估結果。該基金是一種主動管理的交易所交易基金（「ETF」），試圖透過使用衍生性商品（即掉期協議和/或上市選擇權合約）來實現標的證券股價每日百分比變化的兩倍（200%）。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: iShares MSCI Emerging Markets Asia ETF seeks to track the investment results of the MSCI EM Asia Custom Capped Index. The fund generally will invest at least 80% of its assets in the component securities of the underlying index and in investments that have economic characteristics that are substantially identical to the component securities of the underlying index. The underlying index is designed to measure equity market performance in the emerging market countries of Asia. The underlying index includes large- and mid-capitalization companies and may change over time.
info.description_zh: iShares MSCI 新興市場亞洲 ETF 旨在追蹤 MSCI 新興市場亞洲客製化上限指數的投資結果。該基金通常將至少 80% 的資產投資於標的指數的組成證券以及具有與標的指數的組成證券基本相同的經濟特徵的投資。相關指數旨在衡量亞洲新興市場國家的股票市場表現。基礎指數包括大中型公司，並可能隨著時間的推移而變化。

info.description: First Trust Mid Cap Growth AlphaDEX Fund seeks investment results that correspond generally to the price and yield (before the fund's fees and expenses) of an equity index called the Nasdaq AlphaDEX Mid Cap Growth Index. The fund will normally invest at least 90% of its net assets (including investment borrowings) in the common stocks that comprise the index. The index is designed to select growth stocks from the NASDAQ US 600 Mid Cap Index TM (the "base index") that may generate positive alpha, or risk-adjusted returns, relative to traditional indices through the use of the AlphaDEX selection methodology.
info.description_zh: First Trust Mid Cap Growth AlphaDEX 基金尋求的投資結果通常與稱為納斯達克 AlphaDEX Mid Cap Growth Index 的股票指數的價格和收益率（在基金費用和開支之前）相對應。該基金通常將至少 90% 的淨資產（包括投資借款）投資於構成該指數的普通股。該指數旨在從納斯達克美國 600 中型股指數 TM（「基礎指數」）中選擇成長型股票，透過使用 AlphaDEX 選擇方法，相對於傳統指數，這些股票可能會產生正的 alpha 或風險調整回報。

info.description: Wisdomtree Core Laddered Municipal Fund seeks to generate current income that is exempt from federal income taxes. The manager seeks to achieve its investment objective primarily through investments in municipal debt securities whose interest payments generally are exempt from U.S. federal income taxes. Under normal circumstances, the fund invests at least 80% of its net assets (plus the amount of any borrowings for investment purposes) in municipal debt securities. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: Wisdomtree Core Laddered 市政基金尋求產生免徵聯邦所得稅的當前收入。該管理人主要透過投資市政債務證券來實現其投資目標，這些證券的利息支付通常免徵美國聯邦所得稅。在正常情況下，該基金將至少 80% 的淨資產（加上任何用於投資目的的借款金額）投資於市政債務證券。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: First Trust Nasdaq BuyWrite Income ETF seeks to provide current income. The fund will pursue its investment objective by investing primarily in equity securities listed on U.S. exchanges and by utilizing an "option strategy" consisting of writing (selling) U.S. exchange-traded call options on the Nasdaq-100 Index. The call options written by the fund will have expirations of less than one year, and will be typically written at-the-money to out-of-the-money.
info.description_zh: First Trust Nasdaq BuyWrite Income ETF 尋求提供當前收入。該基金將透過主要投資於美國交易所上市的股本證券以及利用「選擇權策略」來實現其投資目標，其中包括賣出（出售）納斯達克 100 指數的美國交易所交易看漲期權。該基金所簽發的買權的到期日將少於一年，並且通常會以平價或價外形式出售。

info.description: Idea Acquisition Corp. operates as a blank check company. It was formed for the purpose of effecting a merger, amalgamation, share exchange, asset acquisition, share purchase, reorganization or similar business combination with one or more businesses. The company was founded on September 18, 2025 and is headquartered in Los Angeles, CA.
info.description_zh: Idea Acquisition Corp. 作為一家空白支票公司運作。它的成立目的是與一個或多個企業進行合併、合併、股份交換、資產收購、股份購買、重組或類似的業務合併。該公司成立於2025年9月18日，總部位於加州洛杉磯。

info.description: Ascentage Pharma Group International Co., Ltd. is a clinical-stage biotechnology company. It engages in the development of novel therapies for cancers, hepatitis B virus, or HBV, and age-related diseases. The company was founded by Da Jun Yang, Wang Shao Meng and Ming Guo in May 2009 and is headquartered in Suzhou, China.
info.description_zh: 亞盛醫藥集團國際有限公司是一家臨床階段的生技公司。它致力於開發癌症、乙型肝炎病毒或 HBV 以及與年齡相關的疾病的新療法。該公司由楊大軍、王少萌和郭明於2009年5月創立，總部位於中國蘇州。

info.description: Global X Hydrogen ETF seeks to provide investment results that correspond generally to the price and yield performance, before fees and expenses, of the Solactive Global Hydrogen Index. The fund invests at least 80% of its total assets, plus borrowings for investments purposes (if any), in the securities of the index and in American Depositary Receipts ("ADRs") and Global Depositary Receipts ("GDRs") based on the securities in the index. The underlying index is designed to provide exposure to companies that are positioned to benefit from further advances in the field of hydrogen technology. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: Global X Hydrogen ETF 力求提供與 Solactive Global Hydrogen Index 的價格和收益表現（未計費用和開支）大致相符的投資結果。該基金將至少 80% 的總資產以及用於投資目的的借款（如有）投資於指數證券以及基於指數證券的美國存託憑證（「ADR」）和全球存託憑證（「GDR」）。該指數旨在為那些能夠從氫技術領域的進一步進步中受益的公司提供投資機會。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Blackrock Short-Term California Muni Bond ETF seeks to maximize tax-free current income by investing in short-term municipal bonds issued in the State of California. Under normal circumstances, the fund will primarily invest in U.S. dollar-denominated investment-grade short-term fixed- and floating-rate municipal securities issued by California with remaining maturities of five years or less, such as municipal bonds, municipal notes and variable rate demand obligations, as well as money market instruments and registered investment companies. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: 貝萊德短期加州市政債券 ETF 尋求透過投資加州發行的短期市政債券來最大化免稅當期收入。一般情況下，該基金將主要投資於加州發行的、剩餘期限為五年或以下的以美元計價的投資等級短期固定和浮動利率市政證券，例如市政債券、市政票據和浮動利率即期債券，以及貨幣市場工具和註冊投資公司。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Eagle Bancorp, Inc. operates as a bank holding company, which engages in the provision of commercial banking services. The firm offers checking accounts, business savings accounts, online and mobile banking, insurance, and investment advisory services, borrowing, and treasury management. Its customers include sole proprietors, small and medium-sized businesses, partnerships, corporations, non-profit organizations and associations, and investors living and working in and near the bank's primary service area. The company was founded on October 28, 1997 and is headquartered in Bethesda, MD.
info.description_zh: Eagle Bancorp, Inc. 以銀行控股公司經營，提供商業銀行服務。該公司提供支票帳戶、企業儲蓄帳戶、線上和行動銀行、保險、投資諮詢服務、借款和資金管理。其客戶包括獨資經營者、中小型企業、合夥企業、公司、非營利組織和協會，以及在銀行主要服務區域內和附近生活和工作的投資者。該公司成立於1997年10月28日，總部位於馬裡蘭州貝塞斯達。

info.description: ASML Holding NV engages in the development, production, marketing, sales, upgrading and servicing of advanced semiconductor equipment systems. It includes lithography, metrology and inspection systems. The company was founded on April 1, 1984 and is headquartered in Veldhoven, the Netherlands.
info.description_zh: ASML Holding NV 從事先進半導體設備系統的開發、生產、行銷、銷售、升級和服務。它包括光刻、計量和檢測系統。該公司成立於1984年4月1日，總部位於荷蘭費爾德霍芬。

info.description: Astoria Dynamic Core US Fixed Income ETF seeks current income. The fund is an actively managed exchange-traded fund ("ETF") that seeks to achieve its investment objective by investing primarily in other U.S. fixed income ETFs. Under normal circumstances, the fund will invest at least 80% of its net assets (plus the amount of borrowing for investment purposes) directly or indirectly in U.S. fixed income securities. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: Astoria Dynamic Core 美國固定收益 ETF 尋求當前收益。該基金是一檔主動管理的交易所交易基金（「ETF」），旨在透過主要投資於其他美國固定收益 ETF 來實現其投資目標。一般情況下，基金將至少80%的淨資產（加上投資目的借款金額）直接或間接投資於美國固定收益證券。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Centurion Acquisition Corp. is a blank check company. It was formed for the purpose of effecting a merger, share exchange, asset acquisition, share purchase, reorganization, or similar business combination with one or more businesses. The company was founded on January 18, 2024 and is headquartered in New York, NY.
info.description_zh: Centurion Acquisition Corp. 是一家空白支票公司。它的成立目的是與一個或多個企業進行合併、股份交換、資產收購、股份購買、重組或類似的業務合併。該公司成立於2024年1月18日，總部位於紐約州紐約。

info.description: Direxion Daily ASML Bull 2X ETF seeks daily investment results, before fees and expenses, of 200% of the daily performance of the common stock of ASML Holding N.V. The fund employs financial derivative instruments to provide concentrated, leveraged exposure to a global leader in photolithography systems for the semiconductor industry, intended for sophisticated investors to manage short-term risk or execute tactical views.
info.description_zh: Direxion Daily ASML Bull 2X ETF 尋求 ASML Holding N.V. 普通股每日表現 200% 的每日投資結果（未計費用和開支）。該基金採用金融衍生工具，為半導體產業光刻系統的全球領導者提供集中的槓桿投資，旨在幫助經驗豐富的投資者管理短期風險或執行戰術觀點。

info.description: Global X AI Semiconductor & Quantum ETF seeks to provide investment results that correspond generally to the price and yield performance, before fees and expenses, of the Global X AI Semiconductor & Quantum Index. The fund invests at least 80% of its net assets, plus borrowings for investment purposes, in the securities of the underlying index), which may include common stocks, ADRs and GDRs. The underlying index, as presently constituted, is designed to track the performance of companies that are involved in the artificial intelligence ("AI") semiconductor and quantum computing ecosystems. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: Global X AI 半導體和量子 ETF 力求提供與 Global X AI 半導體和量子指數未計費用和開支前的價格和收益率表現大致相符的投資結果。該基金將至少 80% 的淨資產（加上用於投資目的的借款）投資於相關指數的證券，其中可能包括普通股、ADR 和 GDR。目前構成的基礎指數旨在追蹤參與人工智慧（「AI」）半導體和量子運算生態系統的公司的表現。該基金是非多元化的。

Cellectis SA operates as a clinical stage biotechnological company, which engages in gene-editing platform to develop cell and gene therapies. The company was founded by David J. Sourdive and Andre Choulika on February 20, 1999 and is headquartered in Paris, France.
info.description_zh: Cellectis SA 是一家臨床階段生物技術公司，致力於開發細胞和基因療法的基因編輯平台。該公司由David J. Sourdive和Andre Choulika於1999年2月20日創立，總部位於法國巴黎。

info.description: Direxion Daily CSCO Bear 1X Shares seeks daily investment results, before fees and expenses, of 100% of the inverse (or opposite) of the daily performance of CSCO. The fund, under normal circumstances, invests at least 80% of the fund's net assets (plus borrowings for investment purposes) in financial instruments, including swap agreements and options, that, in combination, provide 1X daily inverse (opposite) or short exposure to CSCO, consistent with the fund's investment objective. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: Direxion Daily CSCO Bear 1X Shares 尋求與 CSCO 每日表現相反（或相反）的 100% 的每日投資表現（扣除費用和開支）。在正常情況下，該基金將至少 80% 的基金淨資產（加上投資目的借款）投資於金融工具，包括掉期協議和選擇權，這些金融工具結合起來為 CSCO 提供 1 倍的每日反向（相反）或空頭敞口，這與基金的投資目標一致。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Cyabra, Inc. engages in the provision of data authentication analysis. The firm provides a software that detects fake information and mitigates it in real time. It also helps discover AI-generated content, bot networks, fake profiles, and deepfakes. The company was founded by Dan Brahmy, Yossef Daar and Ido Shraga in July 2017 and is headquartered in Tel Aviv, Israel.
info.description_zh: Cyabra, Inc. 從事提供資料認證分析。該公司提供了一種軟體，可以檢測虛假資訊並即時消除虛假資訊。它還有助於發現人工智慧生成的內容、機器人網路、虛假個人資料和深度偽造品。該公司由 Dan Brahmy、Yossef Daar 和 Ido Shraga 於 2017 年 7 月創立，總部位於以色列特拉維夫。

info.description: Roman DBDR Acquisition Corp. II operates as a blank check company. It was incorporated for the purpose of effecting a merger, amalgamation, share exchange, asset acquisition, share purchase, reorganization or similar business combination with one or more businesses. The company was founded on July 25, 2024 and is headquartered in Boca Raton, FL.
info.description_zh: Roman DBDR Acquisition Corp. II 以空白支票公司經營。它的成立目的是與一個或多個企業進行合併、合併、股份交換、資產收購、股份購買、重組或類似業務合併。該公司成立於 2024 年 7 月 25 日，總部位於佛羅裡達州博卡拉頓。

info.description: Dermata Therapeutics, Inc. is a clinical-stage medical dermatology company that focuses on identifying, developing, and commercializing pharmaceutical product candidates for the treatment of medical and aesthetic skin diseases. The company was founded by David F. Hale and Gerald T. Proehl on December 8, 2014 and is headquartered in San Diego, CA.
info.description_zh: Dermata Therapeutics, Inc. 是一家臨床階段的醫學皮膚科公司，專注於識別、開發和商業化用於治療醫學和美容皮膚病的候選藥物。該公司由 David F. Hale 和 Gerald T. Proehl 於 2014 年 12 月 8 日創立，總部位於加利福尼亞州聖地亞哥。

info.description: WEBs Defined Volatility XLRE ETF seeks to provide investment results that, before fees and expenses, correspond to the performance of the Syntax Defined Volatility XLRE Index. The fund implements its investment objective by investing, under normal market conditions, at least 80% of its net assets in financial instruments that achieve the investment results of the index. The index is a rules-based strategy that seeks to track the net asset value of a portfolio of securities of companies in the real estate sector of the large-cap U.S. equity market. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: WEBs Defined Volatility XLRE ETF 力求提供扣除費用和開支先前與 Syntax Defined Volatility XLRE 指數表現相對應的投資結果。該基金透過在正常市場條件下將至少80%的淨資產投資於實現指數投資結果的金融工具來實現其投資目標。該指數是一種基於規則的策略，旨在追蹤美國大盤股市場房地產行業公司證券投資組合的資產淨值。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: iShares ESG Aware MSCI EM ETF seeks to track the investment results of the MSCI Emerging Markets Extended ESG Focus Index. The fund generally will invest at least 90% of its assets in the component securities of the underlying index and in investments that have economic characteristics that are substantially identical to the component securities of the underlying index. The index is an optimized equity index designed to reflect the equity performance of companies that have favorable ESG characteristics, while exhibiting risk and return characteristics similar to those of the MSCI Emerging Markets Index (the "parent index").
info.description_zh: iShares ESG Aware MSCI EM ETF 旨在追踪 MSCI 新兴市场扩展 ESG 焦点指数的投资结果。該基金通常將至少 90% 的資產投資於標的指數的組成證券以及具有與標的指數的組成證券基本相同的經濟特徵的投資。該指數是優化的股票指數，旨在反映具有良好 ESG 特徵的公司的股票表現，同時表現出與 MSCI 新興市場指數（「母指數」）類似的風險和回報特徵。

info.description: FitLife Brands, Inc. engages in the provision of nutritional supplements for health conscious consumers. Its brands include NDS Nutrition, PMD Sports, SirenLabs, Core Active, Nutrology, Metis Nutrition, iSatori, BioGenetic Laboratories, Energize, Maritime Naturals and MusclePharm. The company was founded by Scott D. Landow on July 26, 2005 and is headquartered in Omaha, NE.
info.description_zh: FitLife Brands, Inc. 致力於為注重健康的消費者提供營養補充品。其品牌包括 NDS Nutrition、PMD Sports、SirenLabs、Core Active、Nutrology、Metis Nutrition、iSatori、BioGenetic Laboratories、Energize、Maritime Naturals 和 MusclePharm。該公司由 Scott D. Landow 於 2005 年 7 月 26 日創立，總部位於內布拉斯加州奧馬哈。

info.description: Gladstone Commercial Corp. is a real estate investment trust, which engages in the acquisition, managing and ownership of office and industrial properties. The company was founded by David John Gladstone on February 14, 2003 and is headquartered in McLean, VA.
info.industry_zh: 房地產投資信託基金 - 多元化
info.description_zh: Gladstone Commercial Corp. 是一家房地產投資信託公司，從事辦公大樓和工業地產的收購、管理和所有權。該公司由 David John Gladstone 於 2003 年 2 月 14 日創立，總部位於維吉尼亞州麥克萊恩。

info.description: Astoria US Quality Growth Kings ETF seeks to provide long-term capital appreciation. The fund is an actively managed exchange-traded fund ("ETF") that seeks to achieve its investment objective by investing, under normal circumstances, at least 80% of its net assets (plus the amount of any borrowings for investment purposes) in equity securities (including depositary receipts) of issuers outside the U.S. that the fund's sub-adviser, Astoria Portfolio Advisors, LLC (the "Sub-Adviser") believes has the potential for growth.
info.description_zh: Astoria US Quality Growth Kings ETF 尋求提供長期資本增值。該基金是一檔主動管理型交易所交易基金（「ETF」），旨在透過在正常情況下將至少 80% 的淨資產（加上任何用於投資目的的借款金額）投資於美國境外發行人的股本證券（包括存託憑證）來實現其投資目標，該基金的副顧問 Astoria Portfolio, LLC（「顧問」具有成長潛力）。

info.description: Golden Eagle Dynamic Hypergrowth ETF seeks capital appreciation. The fund is an actively managed exchange-traded fund that seeks to achieve its investment objective by investing, under normal market conditions, at least 80% of its net assets (plus any borrowings for investment purposes) in the common stock of "hypergrowth companies.
info.description_zh: 金鷹動態超增長ETF尋求資本增值。該基金是一檔主動管理的交易所交易基金，旨在透過在正常市場條件下將至少 80% 的淨資產（加上任何用於投資目的的借款）投資於「高速成長公司」的普通股來實現其投資目標。

info.description: Indigo Acquisition Corp. is blank check company for the purpose of effecting a merger, share exchange, asset acquisition, share purchase and reorganization. Its objective is to identify and acquire an established, profitable company with strong fundamentals and significant upside potential. The company was founded on June 07, 2024 and is headquartered in Miami, FL.
info.description_zh: Indigo Acquisition Corp. 是一家空白支票公司，旨在進行合併、股份交換、資產收購、股份購買和重組。其目標是識別並收購一家基礎雄厚且具有巨大上升潛力的成熟、盈利的公司。該公司成立於 2024 年 6 月 7 日，總部位於佛羅裡達州邁阿密。

info.description: Newbridge Acquisition Ltd. is a blank check company. It was created for the purpose of effecting a merger, share exchange, asset acquisition, share purchase, recapitalization, reorganization or similar business combination. The company was founded on April 16, 2021 and is headquartered in Hong Kong.
info.description_zh: Newbridge Acquisition Ltd. 是一家空白支票公司。它的創建目的是實現合併、股份交換、資產收購、股份購買、資本重組、重組或類似的業務合併。該公司成立於2021年4月16日，總部位於香港。

info.description: WisdomTree Japan Hedged SmallCap Equity Fund seeks to track the price and yield performance, before fees and expenses, of the WisdomTree Japan Hedged SmallCap Equity Index. The fund normally invests at least 80% of its total assets in component securities of the index and investments that have economic characteristics that are substantially identical to the economic characteristics of such component securities. The index is a dividend weighted index designed to provide exposure to Japanese equity markets while at the same time neutralizing exposure to fluctuations of the value of the Japanese yen relative to the U.S. dollar. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: WisdomTree 日本對沖小型股股票基金旨在追蹤 WisdomTree 日本對沖小型股股票指數（未計費用和支出）的價格和收益率表現。該基金通常將其總資產的至少 80% 投資於指數的組成證券以及具有與此類組成證券的經濟特徵基本相同的經濟特徵的投資。該指數是股息加權指數，旨在提供日本股市的曝險，同時抵消日圓相對美元價值波動的曝險。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Ming Shing Group Holdings Ltd. is a holding company, which engages in the business of wet trades such as plastering, brickwork, wall and floor tiling, painting and decoration, floor screeding, and marble works. The firm also involves in construction, renovation, maintenance, addition, and alteration of buildings in mainly residential and commercial segments, as well as industrial buildings, government buildings, community facilities transportation, and public infrastructure. The company was founded on August 2, 2022 and is headquartered in Hong Kong.
info.description_zh: 明成集團控股有限公司是一家控股公司，從事抹灰、磚瓦、牆地磚、油漆及裝飾、地板及大理石工程等濕工業務。該公司還涉及主要住宅和商業領域的建築物的建設、翻新、維護、加建和改造，以及工業建築、政府建築、社區設施交通和公共基礎設施。該公司成立於2022年8月2日，總部位於香港。

info.description: Pacer Nasdaq 100 Top 50 Cash Cows Growth Leaders ETF seeks to track the total return performance, before fees and expenses, of the Pacer Nasdaq 100 Top 50 Cash Cows Growth Leaders Index. The initial Index universe is typically derived from the component companies of the Nasdaq-100 Index. The initial universe of companies is typically screened based on their average projected free cash flows and earnings (if available) over each of the next two fiscal years. Under normal circumstances, the fund will seek to invest at least 80% of the fund's total assets in growth securities. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: Pacer Nasdaq 100 Top 50 Cash Cows Growth Leaders ETF 旨在追蹤 Pacer Nasdaq 100 Top 50 Cash Cows Growth Leaders Index 扣除費用和開支之前的總回報表現。最初的指數範圍通常源自於納斯達克 100 指數的成分公司。公司的初始範圍通常是根據未來兩個財政年度的平均預期自由現金流和收益（如果有）進行篩選的。一般情況下，基金會尋求將基金總資產的至少80%投資於成長型證券。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: The RMR Group, Inc. is a holding company, which engages in the provision of management services to manage equity real estate investment trusts and operators. The company was founded in 1986 and is headquartered in Newton, MA.
info.description_zh: RMR Group, Inc. 是一家控股公司，提供管理股權房地產投資信託和營運商的管理服務。該公司成立於 1986 年，總部位於馬薩諸塞州牛頓。

info.description: SUMA Acquisition Corp. is a blank check company, which was formed for the purpose of effecting a merger, amalgamation, share exchange, asset acquisition, share purchase, reorganization, or similar business combination with one or more businesses or entities. The company was founded by Naseem Saloojee and David King on November 21, 2025 and is headquartered in Toronto, Canada.
info.description_zh: SUMA Acquisition Corp. 是一家空白支票公司，其成立目的是與一個或多個企業或實體進行合併、合併、股份交換、資產收購、股份購買、重組或類似業務合併。該公司由 Naseem Saloojee 和 David King 於 2025 年 11 月 21 日創立，總部位於加拿大多倫多。

info.description: Wisdomtree High Income Laddered Municipal Fund seeks to generate a high level of current income that is exempt from federal income taxes. The manager seeks to achieve its investment objective primarily through investments in municipal debt securities whose interest payments generally are exempt from U.S. federal income taxes. Under normal circumstances, the fund invests at least 80% of its net assets (plus the amount of any borrowings for investment purposes) in high income municipal debt securities. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: Wisdomtree 高收入階梯市政基金旨在產生高水準的當前收入，且免徵聯邦所得稅。該管理人主要透過投資市政債務證券來實現其投資目標，這些證券的利息支付通常免徵美國聯邦所得稅。在正常情況下，該基金將至少 80% 的淨資產（加上任何用於投資目的的借款金額）投資於高收入市政債務證券。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: iShares MSCI Turkey ETF seeks to track the investment results of the MSCI Turkey IMI 25/50 Index. The fund generally will invest at least 80% of its assets in the component securities of the underlying index and in investments that have economic characteristics that are substantially identical to the component securities of the underlying index. The underlying index is designed to measure the performance of the large-, mid- and small-capitalization segments of equity market in Turkey. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: iShares MSCI 土耳其 ETF 旨在追蹤 MSCI 土耳其 IMI 25/50 指數的投資結果。該基金通常將至少 80% 的資產投資於標的指數的組成證券以及具有與標的指數的組成證券基本相同的經濟特徵的投資。該指數旨在衡量土耳其股票市場大、中、小型股的表現。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: First Trust SSI Strategic Convertible Securities ETF seeks total return. Under normal market conditions, the fund seeks to achieve its investment objective by investing at least 80% of its net assets (including investment borrowings) in a portfolio of U.S. and non-U.S. convertible securities. In general, convertible securities combine the investment characteristics of bonds and common stocks and typically consist of debt securities or preferred securities that may be converted or exchanged within a specified period of time into a certain amount of common stock or other equity security of the same or a different issuer.
info.description_zh: First Trust SSI 策略可轉換證券 ETF 尋求總回報。在正常市場條件下，該基金尋求透過將至少 80% 的淨資產（包括投資借款）投資於美國和非美國可轉換證券的投資組合來實現其投資目標。一般來說，可轉換證券結合了債券和普通股的投資特點，通常由可以在指定期限內轉換或交換為相同或不同發行人的一定數量的普通股或其他股本證券的債務證券或優先證券組成。

info.description: Horizon Kinetics Medical ETF seeks to provide long-term growth of capital. The fund is an actively-managed exchange-traded fund ("ETF") that pursues its investment objective by investing, under normal circumstances, at least 80% of its net assets plus any borrowings for investment purposes in common stocks, convertible securities, warrants and other equity securities having the characteristics of common stocks of U.S. and foreign companies engaged in medical research, pharmaceutical and medical technology industries and related technology industries. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: Horizo​​n Kinetics Medical ETF 致力於提供長期的資本成長。該基金是一種主動管理的交易所交易基金（「ETF」），在正常情況下，透過將至少80%的淨資產加上任何用於投資目的的借款投資於從事醫學研究、製藥和醫療技術行業及相關技術行業的美國和外國公司的普通股、可轉換證券、認股權證和其他具有普通股特徵的股本證券來實現其投資目標。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: T. Rowe Price Health Care ETF seeks long-term capital appreciation. The fund normally invests at least 80% of its net assets (plus any borrowings for investment purposes) in the securities of health care companies. The manager defines health care companies as companies engaged in health care innovations, such as developing new and effective therapies; pharmaceuticals; biotechnology; life sciences tools and services; managed health care; and/or health care equipment, supplies, providers, services, distributors, and facilities. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: T. Rowe Price 醫療保健 ETF 尋求長期資本增值。該基金通常將至少 80% 的淨資產（加上任何用於投資目的的借款）投資於醫療保健公司的證券。這位經理將醫療保健公司定義為從事醫療保健創新的公司，例如開發新的有效療法；藥品；生物技術；生命科學工具和服務；管理醫療保健；和/或醫療保健設備、用品、提供者、服務、分銷商和設施。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Jpmorgan Healthcare Leaders ETF seeks to provide long-term capital appreciation. The fund will invest primarily in equity securities issued by pharmaceutical, biotechnology, healthcare services, healthcare technology, medical technology and life sciences companies which the adviser believes are leaders and where the magnitude and/or duration of future growth for these companies is underappreciated by the market. Under normal circumstances, the fund invests at least 80% of its assets in the equity securities of healthcare companies.
info.description_zh: 摩根大通醫療保健領袖 ETF 尋求提供長期資本增值。該基金將主要投資於製藥、生物技術、醫療保健服務、醫療保健技術、醫療技術和生命科學公司發行的股票證券，顧問認為這些公司處於領先地位，並且這些公司未來成長的規模和/或持續時間被市場低估。一般情況下，該基金至少80%的資產投資於醫療保健公司的股權證券。

info.description: Patterson-UTI Energy, Inc. engages in the provision of drilling and pressure pumping services, directional drilling, rental equipment, and technology. It operates through the following segments: Drilling Services, Completion Services, and Drilling Products. The Drilling Services segment represents contract drilling, directional drilling, oilfield technology, and electrical controls and automation businesses. The Completion Services segment offers hydraulic fracturing, wireline and pumping, completion support, cementing, and pressure pumping business. The Drilling Products segment focuses on manufacturing and distribution of drill bits business. The company was founded by Cloyce A. Talbott and A. Glenn Patterson in 1978 and is headquartered in Houston, TX.
info.description_zh: Patterson-UTI Energy, Inc. 從事提供鑽井和壓力泵服務、定向鑽井、租賃設備和技術。該公司透過以下部門運作：鑽井服務部門、完井服務部門和鑽井產品部門。鑽井服務部門涉及合約鑽井、定向鑽井、油田技術以及電氣控制和自動化業務。完井服務部門提供水力壓裂、電纜和泵送、完井支援、固井和壓力泵送業務。鑽井產品部門專注於鑽頭業務的製造和分銷。該公司由 Cloyce A. Talbott 和 A. Glenn Patterson 於 1978 年創立，總部位於德克薩斯州休士頓。

info.description: Construction Partners, Inc. is a civil infrastructure company, which engages in the construction and maintenance of roadways and highways. The firm is also involved in the provision of products and services to both public and private infrastructure projects, with an emphasis on highways, roads, bridges, airports, and commercial and residential developments. The company was founded by Ned N. Fleming, III, R. Alan Palmer, and Charles E. Owens in 1999 and is headquartered in Dothan, AL.
info.description_zh: Construction Partners, Inc. 是一家民用基礎設施公司，從事道路和高速公路的建設和維護。該公司還為公共和私人基礎設施項目提供產品和服務，重點是高速公路、道路、橋樑、機場以及商業和住宅開發項目。該公司由 Ned N. Fleming, III、R. Alan Palmer 和 Charles E. Owens 於 1999 年創立，總部位於阿拉巴馬州多森。

info.description: Franklin Wireless Corp. engages in the provision of wireless solutions including 5G (fifth generation) and 4G LTE (fourth generation long-term evolution). It offers mobile hotspots, routers, fixed wireless routers, various trackers, and software subscription services. It operates through the following geographical segments: North America, and Asia. The company was founded in 1981 and is headquartered in San Diego, CA.
info.description_zh: Franklin Wireless Corp.提供無線解決方案，包括5G（第五代）和4G LTE（第四代長期演進）。它提供行動熱點、路由器、固定無線路由器、各種追蹤器和軟體訂閱服務。它透過以下地理區域運作：北美和亞洲。該公司成立於 1981 年，總部位於加利福尼亞州聖地亞哥。

info.description: VanEck ETF that tracks an index of companies involved in China's semiconductor industry, including chip design, manufacturing, and equipment firms.
info.description_zh: VanEck ETF 追蹤中國半導體產業的公司指數，包括晶片設計、製造和設備公司。

info.description: Lakefront Biotherapeutics is a biotechnology company, which engages in the identification and development of small molecule and antibody therapies. Its clinical pipeline includes filgotinib, GLP3667, Toledo program, and idiopathic pulmonary fibrosis. The company was founded by Onno van de Stolpe, Rudi Pauwels, and Helmuth van Es on June 30, 1999 and is headquartered in Mechelen, Belgium.
info.description_zh: Lakefront Biotherapeutics 是一家生物技術公司，從事小分子和抗體療法的鑑定和開發。其臨床管線包括filgotinib、GLP3667、Toledo計畫、特發性肺纖維化等。該公司由 Onno van de Stolpe、Rudi Pauwels 和 Helmuth van Es 於 1999 年 6 月 30 日創立，總部位於比利時梅赫倫。

info.description: QuantumScape Corp. engages in developing next-generation solid-state lithium-metal batteries. The company's next-generation batteries are designed to enable greater energy density, faster charging, and enhanced safety to support the transition away from legacy energy sources toward a lower-carbon future. The company was founded by Jagdeep Singh, Tim Holme, and Fritz B. Prinz in May 2010 and is headquartered in San Jose, CA.
info.description_zh: QuantumScape Corp. 致力於開發新一代固態鋰金屬電池。該公司的下一代電池旨在實現更高的能量密度、更快的充電速度和更高的安全性，以支持從傳統能源向低碳未來的過渡。該公司由 Jagdeep Singh、Tim Holme 和 Fritz B. Prinz 於 2010 年 5 月創立，總部位於加州聖荷西。

info.description: AEye, Inc. engages in the provision of high-performance, active lidar systems for vehicle autonomy, advanced driver-assistance systems (ADAS), and robotic vision applications. It specializes in computer vision, autonomous driving, robotic vision, autonomous vehicles, lidar, sensor fusion, and three-dimensional mapping. The company was founded by Luis C. Dussan, Ransom P. Wuller, Barry Behnken, and Jordan Greene in 2013 and is headquartered in Pleasanton, CA.
info.description_zh: AEye, Inc. 致力於為車輛自動駕駛、高級駕駛員輔助系統 (ADAS) 和機器人視覺應用提供高性能主動雷射雷達系統。它專注於電腦視覺、自動駕駛、機器人視覺、自動駕駛汽車、光達、感測器融合和三維測繪。該公司由 Luis C. Dussan、Ransom P. Wuller、Barry Behnken 和 Jordan Greene 於 2013 年創立，總部位於加州普萊森頓。

info.description: Sigma Lithium Corp. engages in the producing of a lithium property. It focuses its project in Minas Gerais. The firm also plans to build a world-class commercial-scale lithium concentration plant. The company was founded on June 8, 2011 and is headquartered in Sao Paulo, Brazil.
info.description_zh: Sigma Lithium Corp. 從事鋰資產的生產。它的項目集中在米納斯吉拉斯州。該公司還計劃建造一座世界級的商業規模鋰濃縮廠。該公司成立於2011年6月8日，總部位於巴西聖保羅。

info.description: Next Technology Holding, Inc. engages in the provision of software development services to the customers and bitcoin acquisition. The company was founded on March 28, 2019 and is headquartered in Shenzhen, China.
info.description_zh: Next Technology Holding, Inc. 從事向客戶提供軟體開發服務和比特幣收購業務。公司成立於2019年3月28日，總部位於中國深圳。

info.description: Zevra Therapeutics, Inc. is a commercial-stage rare disease company that combines science, data and patient needs to create therapies for diseases with limited or no treatment options. The firm focuses on the treatment of rare neurological and sleep conditions such as certain Urea Cycle Disorders, Niemann Pick Disease Type C and Idiopathic Hypersomnia. The company receives royalties for AZSTARYS from its commercial partner Corium. The company was founded by Christal M. M. Mickle and Travis C. Mickle on October 30, 2006 and is headquartered in Celebration, FL.
info.description_zh: Zevra Therapeutics, Inc. 是一家商業階段的罕見疾病公司，它將科學、數據和患者需求結合起來，為治療選擇有限或沒有治療選擇的疾病創造療法。該公司專注於治療罕見的神經系統和睡眠疾病，例如某些尿素循環障礙、C 型尼曼匹克病和特發性嗜睡症。該公司從其商業合作夥伴 Corium 處獲得 AZSTARYS 的特許權使用費。該公司由 Christal M. M. Mickle 和 Travis C. Mickle 於 2006 年 10 月 30 日創立，總部位於佛羅裡達州 Celebration。

info.description: Cardio Diagnostics Holdings, Inc. engages in the provision of medical diagnostic testing services. It also develops and commercializes a series of products for major types of cardiovascular disease and associated comorbidities, including coronary heart disease (CHD), stroke, heart failure, and diabetes. The company was founded by Meeshanthini V. Dogan and Robert Philibert in 2017 and is headquartered in Chicago, IL.
info.description_zh: Cardio Diagnostics Holdings, Inc. 從事提供醫療診斷測試服務。它還開發和商業化一系列針對主要類型心血管疾病和相關合併症的產品，包括冠狀動脈心臟病（CHD）、中風、心臟衰竭和糖尿病。該公司由 Meeshanthini V. Dogan 和 Robert Philibert 於 2017 年創立，總部位於伊利諾伊州芝加哥。

info.description: Surrozen, Inc. is a clinical stage biotechnology company, which engages in the business of discovering and developing drug candidates to selectively modulate the Wnt pathway, a critical mediator of tissue repair, in a broad range of organs and tissues. The company was founded by K. Christopher Garcia and Roeland Nusse on August 12, 2015 and is headquartered in South San Francisco, CA.
info.description_zh: Surrozen, Inc. 是一家臨床階段生物技術公司，從事發現和開發候選藥物的業務，以選擇性地調節廣泛器官和組織中組織修復的關鍵介質 Wnt 通路。該公司由 K. Christopher Garcia 和 Roeland Nusse 於 2015 年 8 月 12 日創立，總部位於加利福尼亞州南舊金山。

info.description: China Sxt Pharmaceuticals, Inc. operates as a holding company, which engages in the research, development, manufacture, marketing, and sales of traditional Chinese medicine pieces (TCMP). Its product categories include directly-oral, after-soaking-oral, fine, and regular TCMP. The firm distributes its product under the Suxuantang brand. The company was founded by Feng Zhou in 2005 and is headquartered in Taizhou, China.
info.industry_zh: 藥品製造商 - 特用藥品和非專利藥品
info.description_zh: 中國Sxt Pharmaceuticals, Inc.作為一家控股公司，從事中藥飲片（TCMP）的研究、開發、製造、行銷和銷售。其產品類別包括直接口服、浸泡後口服、精品、一般中藥。該公司以蘇玄堂品牌分銷其產品。該公司由周鋒於2005年創立，總部位於中國台州。

info.description: Addentax Group Corp. is a holding company, along with its subsidiaries, engages in the textile and garments industry. It operates through the following segments: Garment Manufacturing, Logistics Services, and Property Management and Subleasing. The Garments Manufacturing segment focuses on manufacturing and distribution of garments. The Logistics Services segment includes delivery and courier services covering some provinces in China. The Property Management and Subleasing segment offers services for wholesalers and retailers. The company was founded on October 28, 2014 and is headquartered in Shenzhen, China.
info.description_zh: Addentax Group Corp. 是一家控股公司，及其子公司從事紡織和服裝行業。它透過以下部門運作：服裝製造部門、物流服務部門以及物業管理和分租賃部門。服裝製造部門專注於服裝的製造和分銷。物流服務部門包括涵蓋中國部分省份的送貨和快遞服務。物業管理和分租部門為批發商和零售商提供服務。公司成立於2014年10月28日，總部位於中國深圳。

info.description: Fingermotion Inc. is a mobile data specialist company, which engages in the provision of payment and recharge service, data plans, subscription plans, mobile phones, loyalty points redemption, and other product bundles. It operates through the following segments: Telecommunications and Product Services, Value Added Products and Services, Short Message Services and Multimedia Messaging Services, Rich Communication Services Platform, and Big Data Insights. The company was founded on January 23, 2014 and is headquartered in Singapore.
info.description_zh: Fingermotion Inc.是一家行動數據專業公司，提供支付和儲值服務、數據計劃、訂閱計劃、手機、忠誠積分兌換和其他產品捆綁。它透過以下部門運作：電信和產品服務、增值產品和服務、簡訊服務和多媒體訊息服務、豐富的通訊服務平台和大數據洞察。該公司成立於2014年1月23日，總部位於新加坡。
